definitions.source: times_preview = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv", preview=5)
times_raw = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv")
times_typed = cast(times_raw, year=int64, teaching=float64, international=float64, research=float64, citations=float64, income=float64, total_score=float64, errors="null")
times_2016 = filter(times_typed, lambda row: row["year"] is not None and row["year"] == 2016, doc="Keeps only Times Higher Education records from 2016")
times_2016_scored = map(times_2016, add_formula_total, doc="Adds the THE formula-calculated total score, missing when any required component score is missing")
paired_stats = process(times_2016_scored, fn=pearson_with_pvalue, doc="Computes Pearson correlation and two-sided p-value between official and formula-calculated totals on complete pairs")
official_total_count = aggregate(times_2016_scored, nonmissing_official_total=count("total_score"))

score_missing_flags = map(times_2016_scored, score_and_missing_flags, doc="Fills missing official totals with the THE formula and flags remaining missing totals and rows with any missing cleaned field")
score_missing_counts = aggregate(score_missing_flags, remaining_missing_total=sum("missing_total_flag"), universities_with_any_missing=sum("any_missing_flag"), universities=count())

numeric_rankings = map(times_2016_scored, parse_numeric_rankings, doc="Keeps the ten ranking variables as numeric values, filling missing total scores from the THE formula and preserving unparseable values as missing")

correlation_extremes = process(numeric_rankings, fn=ranking_correlations, doc="Returns the five strongest and five weakest unique Pearson correlations among the ten ranking variables using pairwise-complete observations")

mahalanobis_distances = process(times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=mahalanobis_rows, doc="Computes squared Mahalanobis distance for each university using pairwise-complete means and covariance with a pseudo-inverse")
mahalanobis_ranked = sort(mahalanobis_distances, by=[("mahalanobis_squared", "desc")])
mahalanobis_top5 = limit(mahalanobis_ranked, 5)
cleaning_fields = map(times_2016_scored, prepare_cleaning_fields, doc="Keeps filled total score, numeric student count, and female percentage from the female-to-male field for cleaning")
with_distances = join(cleaning_fields, mahalanobis_distances, on="university_name", how="left", validate="one_to_one", suffix="_distance")
preclean_stats = aggregate(cleaning_fields, mean_total_score=mean("total_score"), sd_total_score=stddev("total_score"), n=count("total_score"))

keep_multivariate = filter(with_distances, lambda row: row["mahalanobis_squared"] is None or row["mahalanobis_squared"] < 25, doc="Keeps universities with missing Mahalanobis distance or squared distance below 25")

complete_univariate_inputs = filter(keep_multivariate, lambda row: row["number_of_students"] is not None and row["female_to_male_ratio"] is not None, doc="Keeps universities with non-missing student count and female-to-male ratio")

cleaned_universities = filter(complete_univariate_inputs, lambda row: row["number_of_students"] < 90000 and row["female_to_male_ratio"] > 5, doc="Keeps universities below 90000 students and above a female-to-male ratio of 5")
postclean_stats = aggregate(cleaned_universities, mean_total_score=mean("total_score"), sd_total_score=stddev("total_score"), n=count("total_score"))
cleaned_count = aggregate(cleaned_universities, universities_remaining=count())

student_distribution_stats = process(cleaned_universities, fn=student_distribution, doc="Summarizes non-missing student counts with mean, median, sample standard deviation, extrema, quartiles, and interquartile range")

correlation_changes = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, correlation_extremes, fn=compare_top_correlations, doc="Compares the five strongest full-dataset correlations with pairwise-complete correlations after outlier removal")
cleaned_score_fields = join(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, on="university_name", how="inner", validate="one_to_one", suffix="_times")
cleaned_scores = map(cleaned_score_fields, prepare_teaching_research, doc="Keeps cleaned universities with teaching, research, and formula-filled total scores")

teaching_research_correlation = process(cleaned_scores, fn=teaching_research_summary, doc="Computes the pairwise-complete Pearson correlation between teaching and research scores in the cleaned dataset")
top_teaching_ranked = sort(cleaned_scores, by=[("teaching_score", "desc"), "university_name"])
top_5_teaching = limit(top_teaching_ranked, 5)

international_score_associations = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=international_score_associations, doc="Computes pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and two-sided p-values between international student percentage and each core ranking score in the cleaned dataset")

research_regression_results = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=research_regression, doc="Fits research score on international student percentage and returns regression statistics plus the three largest positive residuals")

top10_research_residuals = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=top10_research_residuals, doc="Returns the three largest positive research residuals among the ten highest-total-score universities in the cleaned dataset")

student_size_analysis_result = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=student_size_analysis, doc="Computes the pairwise-complete student-count and international-student correlation and lists the five largest and smallest universities by observed student count")
largest_student_universities = filter(student_size_analysis_result, lambda row: row["group"] == "largest", doc="Keeps the five universities with the largest observed student counts")
smallest_student_universities = filter(student_size_analysis_result, lambda row: row["group"] == "smallest", doc="Keeps the five universities with the smallest observed student counts")

small_international_analysis_result = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=small_international_analysis, doc="Compares average research score for small highly international universities with the overall cleaned average and lists the subset's top five research scores")
small_international_summary = filter(small_international_analysis_result, lambda row: row["group"] == "summary", doc="Keeps the subset and overall research-score summary row")
small_international_top5 = filter(small_international_analysis_result, lambda row: row["group"] == "top5", doc="Keeps the five highest-research-score universities in the subset")

small_international_comparison = map(small_international_summary, lambda row: {**row, "average_difference": row["average_research_score"] - row["overall_average_research_score"]}, doc="Adds the subset average research score minus the overall cleaned-dataset average")

gender_income_results = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=gender_income_analysis, doc="Computes simple and STEM-adjusted female-to-male-ratio versus income correlations and counts STEM classifications in the cleaned dataset")

stem_group_comparison = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=stem_group_means_fixed, doc="Compares STEM and non-STEM group means for teaching, research, citations, income, and international student percentage using non-missing values per dimension")

citation_factor_correlations = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=citation_factor_analysis, doc="Computes pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and p-values between citations score and four university characteristics")

stem_international_citations_result = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=stem_international_citations, doc="Compares pairwise-complete internationalization-citations correlations for STEM and non-STEM universities with the full cleaned-dataset correlation")

citations_interaction_regression_result = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=citations_interaction_regression, doc="Fits citations on international student percentage, female-to-male ratio, and their interaction for complete cleaned cases")

research_quality_top5 = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=research_quality_index, doc="Ranks cleaned universities by the average of percentile ranks for citations, research, and international student percentage and records overlap with the official-total top five")

balanced_gender_residuals = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, fn=balanced_residuals, doc="Ranks gender-balanced universities by positive citations residual and reports their research residuals")

outlier_analysis = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_scored, numeric_rankings, mahalanobis_distances, fn=multivariate_outlier_analysis, doc="Summarizes all multivariate outliers and compares their citation correlations with the final cleaned dataset")

turns.question: Among markets with search-interest data and at least 25 single-country title credits in the 2010-2019 window, which five have the strongest early opportunity signal? Return the score and its main components; for simple category breadth, report the raw distinct-category count as genre_count.
turns.judge_error: Incorrect required fields: opportunity_score and demand_gap for Thailand, Turkey, Spain, Egypt, and France. The numeric values do not match the ground truth exactly.

calls.description: Build the conservative 2010–2019 single-country market scan, joining title credits to search summaries and calculating market components and percentile-based scores before the credit screen.
statements: period_titles = filter(cleaned_titles, lambda row: row['added_year'] is not None and 2010 <= row['added_year'] <= 2019, doc='Keeps titles added to Netflix from 2010 through 2019')
sole_country_detail = filter(country_detail, lambda row: row['country_count'] == 1, doc='Keeps only titles whose sole listed country is the market')
assigned_titles = join(sole_country_detail, period_titles, on='show_id', how='inner', suffix='_title', validate='many_to_one')

market_titles = map(assigned_titles, lambda row: {'market': str(row['token']).strip().lower(), 'show_id': row['show_id'], 'title': row['title'], 'type': row['type'], 'rating_group': row['rating_group'], 'added_year': row['added_year'], 'category_text': row['listed_in'], 'credit': float(row['fractional_credit'])}, doc='Standardizes single-country period titles into market credit records')
market_credit = aggregate(market_titles, by=['market'], content_credit=sum('credit'), title_count=count(), adult_credit=sum('credit'), movie_credit=sum('credit'))
market_metrics = process(market_titles, search_summary, fn=make_market_metrics, doc='Computes single-country market credit shares, delayed supply, maturity, movie orientation, and category breadth')
scored_markets = sort(market_metrics, by=[('score', 'desc'), 'market'])
eligible_markets = filter(scored_markets, lambda row: row['content_credit'] >= 25, doc='Keeps search-tracked markets with at least 25 single-country title credits')
top_five_markets = limit(eligible_markets, 5)

outcomes.message: added join operator `assigned_titles`; inputs: left = sole_country_detail, right = period_titles
added process operator `market_metrics`; inputs: market_titles, search_summary

calls.description: Build the full-claim 2010–2019 market scan from all listed-country rows, recompute the percentile-based opportunity score over search-tracked markets, and compare eligible full-claim credit with the conservative scan.
statements: full_country_period = join(country_detail, period_titles, on='show_id', how='inner', suffix='_title', validate='many_to_one')

full_market_titles = map(full_country_period, lambda row: {'market': str(row['token']).strip().lower(), 'show_id': row['show_id'], 'title': row['title'], 'type': row['type'], 'rating_group': row['rating_group'], 'added_year': row['added_year'], 'category_text': row['listed_in'], 'credit': 1.0}, doc='Assigns every period title a full title claim in each listed country market')

definitions.source: file_inventory = process(fn=list_files, doc="Lists the available Netflix catalogue and search-interest data files")
catalogue_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv", preview=3)
search_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/australia.csv", preview=5)
catalogue_raw = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv")
cleaned_titles = process(catalogue_raw, fn=clean_catalogue, doc="Cleans catalogue text and derives parsed addition dates, duration, release decade, release-to-add lag, and compact rating fields")
country_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=make_country, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated countries into ordered tokens with equal fractional credit")
category_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=make_category, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated listed categories into one trimmed row per token")
director_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=make_director, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated directors into one trimmed row per token")
cast_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=make_cast, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated cast into one trimmed row per token")
search_summary = process(fn=load_search_summary, doc="Summarizes each country weekly search series with 2015 and 2019 means, momentum, volatility, and row count")

quality_report = process(cleaned_titles, country_detail, category_detail, director_detail, cast_detail, search_summary, fn=make_quality_report, doc="Reports retained title and detail row counts, search-market coverage, and full-table missingness needed for later analyses")
period_titles = filter(cleaned_titles, lambda row: row["added_year"] is not None and 2010 <= row["added_year"] <= 2019, doc="Keeps titles added to Netflix from 2010 through 2019")
sole_country_detail = filter(country_detail, lambda row: row["country_count"] == 1, doc="Keeps only titles whose sole listed country is the market")
assigned_titles = join(sole_country_detail, period_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

market_titles = map(assigned_titles, lambda row: {"market": str(row["token"]).strip().lower(), "show_id": row["show_id"], "title": row["title"], "type": row["type"], "rating_group": row["rating_group"], "added_year": row["added_year"], "category_text": row["listed_in"], "credit": float(row["fractional_credit"])}, doc="Standardizes single-country period titles into market credit records")
market_credit = aggregate(market_titles, by=["market"], content_credit=sum("credit"), title_count=count(), adult_credit=sum("credit"), movie_credit=sum("credit"))
market_metrics = process(market_titles, search_summary, fn=make_market_metrics, doc="Computes single-country market credit shares, delayed supply, maturity, movie orientation, and category breadth")
scored_markets = sort(market_metrics, by=[("score","desc"),"market"])
eligible_markets = filter(scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked markets with at least 25 single-country title credits")
top_five_markets = limit(eligible_markets, 5)

top_five_report = map(top_five_markets, lambda row: {"market": row["market"], "score": round(row["score"],4), "demand_gap": round(row["demand_gap"],4), "delayed_supply": round(row["delayed_supply"],4), "adult_fit": round(row["adult_fit"],4), "movie_orientation": round(row["movie_orientation"],4), "genre_count": int(row["genre_count"])}, doc="Rounds the top-five market opportunity scores and components to four decimal places while preserving genre counts")
dominant_components = map(top_five_markets, dominant_contribution, doc="Identifies the largest weighted opportunity-score contribution for each selected market")
full_country_period = join(country_detail, period_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

full_market_titles = map(full_country_period, lambda row: {"market": str(row["token"]).strip().lower(), "show_id": row["show_id"], "title": row["title"], "type": row["type"], "rating_group": row["rating_group"], "added_year": row["added_year"], "category_text": row["listed_in"], "credit": 1.0}, doc="Assigns every period title a full title claim in each listed country market")

full_market_metrics = process(full_market_titles, search_summary, fn=make_full_metrics, doc="Computes full-claim market credit shares, delayed supply, maturity, movie orientation, and category breadth")
full_scored_markets = sort(full_market_metrics, by=[("score","desc"),"market"])
full_eligible_markets = filter(full_scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked full-claim markets with at least 25 title credits")
full_top_five = limit(full_eligible_markets, 5)
full_credit_gains = join(full_eligible_markets, market_credit, on="market", how="left", suffix="_conservative", validate="many_to_one")

full_comparison = process(full_top_five, top_five_markets, full_credit_gains, fn=make_comparison, doc="Reports top-five entrants, departing conservative leaders, and largest eligible full-claim title-credit gains")

fractional_market_titles = map(full_country_period, lambda row: {"market": str(row["token"]).strip().lower(), "show_id": row["show_id"], "title": row["title"], "type": row["type"], "rating_group": row["rating_group"], "added_year": row["added_year"], "category_text": row["listed_in"], "credit": float(row["fractional_credit"])}, doc="Assigns each period title equal fractional credit in every listed country market")
fractional_market_metrics = process(fractional_market_titles, search_summary, fn=make_fractional_metrics, doc="Computes fractional-credit market opportunity components and percentile-based scores")
fractional_scored_markets = sort(fractional_market_metrics, by=[("score","desc"),"market"])
fractional_eligible_markets = filter(fractional_scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked fractional-credit markets with at least 25 title credits")
fractional_top_five = limit(fractional_eligible_markets, 5)

inflated_markets = process(full_eligible_markets, fractional_eligible_markets, fn=compare_fractional_standing, doc="Compares full-claim and fractional-credit market standings and reports the five largest rank inflations")
fractional_top_five_report = map(fractional_top_five, round_fractional_top, doc="Rounds the fractional-credit top-five market scores and credits for reporting")
inflated_markets_report = map(inflated_markets, round_inflated, doc="Formats the five markets with the greatest full-claim rank inflation")

leader_visibility = process(fractional_top_five, full_scored_markets, fn=compare_leader_visibility, doc="Checks whether each fractional-credit leader ranked among the top five under full-claim market assignment")

entropy_market_metrics = process(fractional_market_titles, category_detail, search_summary, fn=make_entropy_metrics, doc="Computes fractional-credit opportunity scores using Shannon entropy of category-token credits")
entropy_scored_markets = sort(entropy_market_metrics, by=[("score","desc"),"market"])
entropy_eligible_markets = filter(entropy_scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked entropy markets with at least 25 fractional title credits")

entropy_rank_movement = process(entropy_eligible_markets, fractional_eligible_markets, fn=compare_entropy_ranks, doc="Compares entropy and simple-breadth ranks across every fractional-credit qualified market")
entropy_top_movers = map(entropy_rank_movement, format_entropy_moves, doc="Reports signed rank movement from simple breadth to category entropy")
entropy_top_five = limit(entropy_eligible_markets, 5)
entropy_top_five_report = map(entropy_top_five, format_entropy_top, doc="Reports the new top five entropy-scored markets and entropy breadth components")

full_entropy_market_metrics = process(full_market_titles, category_detail, search_summary, fn=make_full_entropy_metrics, doc="Computes full-claim opportunity scores while retaining Shannon category entropy")
full_entropy_scored_markets = sort(full_entropy_market_metrics, by=[("score","desc"),"market"])
full_entropy_eligible_markets = filter(full_entropy_scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked full-claim entropy markets with at least 25 title credits")
full_entropy_top_five = limit(full_entropy_eligible_markets, 5)

entropy_claim_comparison = process(full_entropy_top_five, entropy_top_five, fn=compare_entropy_claims, doc="Compares full-claim and fractional-credit entropy top-five membership and quantifies the change")

volatility_penalized_metrics = process(entropy_market_metrics, search_summary, fn=add_volatility_penalty, doc="Subtracts 15 percent of each market's full-period search-volatility percentile from the entropy-based opportunity score")
volatility_scored_markets = sort(volatility_penalized_metrics, by=[("penalized_score","desc"),"market"])

volatility_eligible_markets = filter(volatility_scored_markets, lambda row: row["content_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked volatility-penalized markets with at least 25 fractional title credits")
volatility_top_five = limit(volatility_eligible_markets, 5)
volatility_membership_comparison = process(volatility_top_five, entropy_top_five, fn=compare_volatility_membership, doc="Compares volatility-penalized and unpenalized entropy top-five membership")
volatility_top_eight = limit(volatility_eligible_markets, 8)

freshness_pool = process(full_country_period, volatility_top_eight, entropy_market_metrics, fn=calculate_freshness, doc="Computes fractional fresh-supply shares among valid release-to-add lags for the eight volatility-ranked markets, compares demand gap with fresh supply, and adds the freshness shortfall contribution")
freshness_ranked = sort(freshness_pool, by=[("demand_freshness_gap","desc"),"market"])
freshness_top_five = limit(freshness_ranked, 5)
freshness_report = map(freshness_top_five, format_freshness, doc="Reports the five fixed-pool markets where demand gap most exceeds fresh-supply share")

four_year_freshness_comparison = process(full_country_period, volatility_top_eight, entropy_market_metrics, freshness_top_five, fn=calculate_four_year_freshness, doc="Compares four-year freshness-adjusted top-five membership with the current three-year freshness-adjusted ranking")
all_country_catalogue = join(country_detail, cleaned_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

all_fractional_market_titles = map(all_country_catalogue, lambda row: {"market": str(row["token"]).strip().lower(), "show_id": row["show_id"], "added_year": row["added_year"], "credit": float(row["fractional_credit"])}, doc="Assigns each catalogue title equal fractional country credit for continuation measurement")

continuation_metrics = process(all_fractional_market_titles, freshness_pool, entropy_market_metrics, fn=calculate_continuation, doc="Computes 2020-2021 continuation relative to 2018-2019 fractional title credit and adds its percentile contribution to the strict freshness score")
continuation_ranked = sort(continuation_metrics, by=[("post_2019_continuation","desc"),"market"])
continuation_top_five = limit(continuation_ranked, 5)

continuation_report = map(continuation_top_five, lambda row: {"market":row["market"],"post_2019_continuation":round(row["post_2019_continuation"],4),"continuation_adjusted_rank":int(row["continuation_adjusted_rank"])}, doc="Reports the five favored markets with strongest post-2019 supply continuation and their continuation-adjusted opportunity ranks")

prechange_scores=process(full_country_period, volatility_eligible_markets, entropy_market_metrics, all_fractional_market_titles, fn=build_prechange_scores, doc="Builds the strict-freshness and continuation-adjusted fractional opportunity score across all volatility-qualified markets before uncertain-maturity penalization")
prechange_ranked=sort(prechange_scores, by=[('prechange_score','desc'),'market'])
prechange_top_ten=limit(prechange_ranked,10)

uncertain_scored=process(all_fractional_market_titles, prechange_top_ten, cleaned_titles, fn=apply_uncertain_penalty, doc="Penalizes the ten strongest pre-change markets by 10 percent of uncertain-maturity fractional title credit")
uncertain_ranked=sort(uncertain_scored, by=[('updated_score','desc'),'market'])
uncertain_top_five=limit(uncertain_ranked,5)
uncertain_losses=process(prechange_top_ten, uncertain_scored, fn=compare_uncertain, doc="Ranks the five largest standing losses after the uncertain-maturity penalty within the fixed ten-market pool")

uncertain_report=process(uncertain_losses, uncertain_top_five, fn=report_uncertain, doc="Reports the five largest standing losses and the updated top-five markets after uncertain-maturity penalization")

maturity_recovery = process(uncertain_ranked, prechange_scores, fn=compare_maturity_recovery, doc="Ranks the five updated-top-eight markets that recover most score and standing when uncertain maturity labels return to the earlier treatment")

maturity_recovery_report = map(maturity_recovery, lambda row: {"market":row["market"],"earlier_rank":int(row["earlier_rank"]),"updated_rank":int(row["updated_rank_all"]),"rank_movement":int(row["rank_movement"]),"score_recovery":round(row["score_recovery"],4)}, doc="Reports score recovery and rank movement under the earlier maturity treatment")

def add_rating_group(row):
    r = row["rating"]
    if r is None: g = "unrated"
    elif r in ("R", "NC-17", "TV-MA"): g = "adult"

    return {**row, "rating_group": g}

properties.code:
def score_markets(metrics, search):
    import pandas as pd
    x = metrics.merge(search, on="market", how="inner")
    n = len(x)
    def pct(s): return s.rank(method="average", ascending=True) / n * 100.0
    x["content_credit_pct"] = pct(x["title_credit"])
    x["search_momentum_pct"] = pct(x["momentum"])
    x["demand_gap"] = x["search_momentum_pct"] - x["content_credit_pct"]
    x["category_breadth_pct"] = pct(x["genre_count"])
    x["delayed_supply"] = 100.0 - 100.0 * x["delayed_credit"] / x["title_credit"]
    x["adult_fit"] = 100.0 * x["adult_credit"] / x["title_credit"]
    x["movie_orientation"] = 100.0 * x["movie_credit"] / x["title_credit"]
    x["opportunity_score"] = (0.35*x["demand_gap"] + 0.25*x["delayed_supply"] + 0.20*x["adult_fit"] + 0.10*x["movie_orientation"] + 0.10*x["category_breadth_pct"])
    return x[["market","opportunity_score","demand_gap","delayed_supply","adult_fit","movie_orientation","genre_count","title_credit","momentum"]]

def compare_volatility_membership(penalized_top, prior_top):
    import pandas as pd
    new = list(penalized_top["market"])
    old = set(prior_top["market"])
    new_set = set(new)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "penalized_top_five": [", ".join(new)],
        "prior_entropy_top_five": [", ".join(prior_top["market"].tolist())],
        "markets_entering": [", ".join(sorted(new_set - old))],
        "markets_leaving": [", ".join(sorted(old - new_set))],
        "membership_changed": [bool(new_set != old)],
        "number_changed": [len(new_set.symmetric_difference(old)) // 2]
    })

def compare_volatility_membership(penalized_top, prior_top):

    return pd.DataFrame({
        "penalized_top_five": [", ".join(new)],
        "prior_entropy_top_five": [", ".join(prior_top["market"].tolist())],
        "markets_entering": [", ".join(sorted(new_set - old))],
        "markets_leaving": [", ".join(sorted(old - new_set))],
        "membership_changed": [bool(new_set != old)],
        "number_changed": [len(new_set.symmetric_difference(old)) // 2]
    })

outcomes.message: added process operator `persistence_audit`; inputs: screened_shortlist, ranked_opportunities, full_ranked_opportunities, fractional_ranked_opportunities, entropy_ranked_opportunities, volatility_ranked, freshness_market_scores, continuation_scores_all, uncertain_penalized_scores, structure_ranked, decade_adjusted_ranked, niche_ranked, director_ranked, market_screen

turns.question: Under that mixed historical view, which practical-shortlist markets still rank in the top five, and which markets replace the others?
turns.judge_error: Incorrect required fields: (1) "practical_markets_still_top_five" – agent’s list misses "Hong Kong" and contains only four markets instead of the five in the ground truth. (2) "entered_under_mixed_historical" – agent supplies ["mexico"] but ground truth is empty. (3) "left_under_mixed_historical" – agent supplies ["france"] but ground truth is empty.

calls.description: Construct the mixed historical score from the pre-uncertainty continuation-adjusted score plus the original direct 110-minute long-form contribution, restrict to screen-eligible markets, and compare its top five with the practical shortlist.
statements: mixed_historical_comparison = process(continuation_scores_all, longfilm_market, market_screen, screened_shortlist, fn=mixed_historical_compare, doc='Compares the screened mixed historical score with the practical shortlist using pre-uncertainty continuation scores and the original direct long-form contribution')

outcomes.message: added process operator `mixed_historical_comparison`; inputs: continuation_scores_all, longfilm_market, market_screen, screened_shortlist

The score changes are wrong: the agent provides incorrect numeric values for all markets and includes France instead of Hong Kong. None of the required score changes match the ground truth.

calls.description: Compute the final sensitivity score from the current director-adjusted score by retaining one quarter of freshness, removing the niche-category reward, and applying the existing tighter screen; observe both the revised top five and score changes for all practical-shortlist markets.
statements: final_sensitivity_report = process(director_ranked, freshness_market_scores, niche_adjusted_scores, market_screen, screened_shortlist, fn=final_sensitivity, doc='Reports the screened top five and score changes after reducing freshness to one quarter and removing the rare-category reward')

outcomes.message: added process operator `final_sensitivity_report`; inputs: director_ranked, freshness_market_scores, niche_adjusted_scores, market_screen, screened_shortlist

turns.question: Select three markets for the final expansion recommendation. For each, report the current rank, whether it survived the mixed historical comparison, whether it survived the final sensitivity check, and the main reason it is recommended.
turns.judge_error: Thailand has current_rank 2 but should be 3; Egypt has current_rank 3 but should be 2.

definitions.source: input_files = process(fn=list_input_files, doc="Lists the available source files for the Netflix catalogue and weekly search-interest data")
catalogue_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv", preview=5)
search_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/australia.csv", preview=5)
search_multi_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/multiTimeline.csv", preview=5)
catalogue_raw = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv")
search_long = process(fn=load_search_long, doc="Combines country weekly search-interest files after removing non-date headers and converting dates and values")
titles_clean = map(catalogue_raw, clean_title, doc="Standardizes catalogue text fields, parses mixed-format addition dates, and derives duration, season, decade, and release-to-add fields")
search_summary = process(search_long, fn=summarize_search, doc="Summarizes each search market's 2015 and 2019 mean interest, momentum, and full-period sample volatility")
titles_standard = map(titles_clean, add_rating_group, doc="Adds a compact maturity group while retaining non-missing labels such as NR and UR as available ratings")
country_detail = process(titles_standard, fn=build_country, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated countries into ordered tokens with equal fractional country credit")
category_detail = process(titles_standard, fn=build_category, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated listed categories into trimmed nonempty detail rows")
director_detail = process(titles_standard, fn=build_director, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated directors into trimmed nonempty detail rows")
cast_detail = process(titles_standard, fn=build_cast, doc="Splits each title's comma-separated cast into trimmed nonempty detail rows")

quality_report = process(titles_standard, country_detail, category_detail, director_detail, cast_detail, search_summary, fn=quality_report, doc="Reports retained title and token-detail counts, search-market coverage, and key cleaned-field missingness")
titles_with_country = join(country_detail, titles_standard, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

period_single = filter(titles_with_country, lambda row: row["country_count"] == 1 and row["added_year"] is not None and 2010 <= row["added_year"] <= 2019, doc="Keeps titles added from 2010 through 2019 with exactly one listed country")
market_period = map(period_single, lambda row: {**row, "market": row["country"].strip().lower()}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key from the sole listed country")
market_search = join(market_period, search_summary, on=[("market","country")], how="inner", suffix="_search", validate="many_to_one")
category_market = process(market_search, category_detail, fn=category_counts, doc="Counts distinct assigned categories for each search-tracked market in the conservative title window")
market_metrics = process(market_search, fn=summarize_market, doc="Aggregates title credit and delayed-supply, adult, movie, and demand metrics by search-tracked market")
market_base = join(market_metrics, category_market, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
scored_markets = process(market_base, search_summary, fn=score_markets, doc="Computes percentile-based demand-gap opportunity scores across search-tracked markets before credit screening")
eligible_markets = filter(scored_markets, lambda row: row["title_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps search-tracked markets with at least 25 single-country title credits")
ranked_opportunities = sort(eligible_markets, by=[("opportunity_score","desc"), "market"])
top_five_opportunities = limit(ranked_opportunities, 5)
dominant_components = process(market_base, top_five_opportunities, fn=dominant_score_components, doc="Identifies the largest weighted opportunity-score component for each previously selected market")

full_period = filter(titles_with_country, lambda row: row["added_year"] is not None and 2010 <= row["added_year"] <= 2019, doc="Keeps all title-country claims for titles added from 2010 through 2019")

full_market_period = map(full_period, lambda row: {**row, "market": row["country"].strip().lower(), "claim_credit": 1.0}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key and full title claim for every listed country")
full_market_search = join(full_market_period, search_summary, on=[("market","country")], how="inner", suffix="_search", validate="many_to_one")
full_market_metrics = process(full_market_search, fn=summarize_full_market, doc="Aggregates full-claim title supply and delayed-supply, adult, movie, and demand metrics by search-tracked market")
full_category_market = process(full_market_search, category_detail, fn=category_counts_full, doc="Counts distinct assigned categories for each search-tracked market in the full-claim title window")
full_market_base = join(full_market_metrics, full_category_market, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
full_scored_markets = process(full_market_base, search_summary, fn=score_full_markets, doc="Computes the same percentile-based opportunity score for full-claim markets before credit screening")
full_eligible_markets = filter(full_scored_markets, lambda row: row["title_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps full-claim search-tracked markets with at least 25 title credits")
full_ranked_opportunities = sort(full_eligible_markets, by=[("opportunity_score","desc"), "market"])
full_top_five = limit(full_ranked_opportunities, 5)

credit_comparison = process(full_market_metrics, market_metrics, full_top_five, top_five_opportunities, fn=compare_full_claims, doc="Compares full-claim and conservative market credits and identifies top-five entrants, exits, and credit gains")
full_top_changes = process(full_top_five, top_five_opportunities, fn=top_changes, doc="Lists markets entering or leaving the top five under full-claim assignment")

fractional_market_metrics = process(full_market_search, fn=summarize_fractional_market, doc="Aggregates equal-fraction country title credit and delayed-supply, adult, movie, and demand metrics by search-tracked market")

fractional_category_market = process(full_market_search, category_detail, fn=category_counts_fractional, doc="Counts distinct categories assigned to each search-tracked market in the fractional-credit title window")
fractional_market_base = join(fractional_market_metrics, fractional_category_market, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")

fractional_scored_markets = process(fractional_market_base, search_summary, fn=score_fractional_markets, doc="Computes the same percentile-based opportunity score for fractional-credit co-production markets")
fractional_eligible_markets = filter(fractional_scored_markets, lambda row: row["title_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps fractional-credit search-tracked markets with at least 25 title credits")
fractional_ranked_opportunities = sort(fractional_eligible_markets, by=[("opportunity_score","desc"), "market"])
fractional_top_five = limit(fractional_ranked_opportunities, 5)

fractional_inflation = process(full_ranked_opportunities, fractional_ranked_opportunities, full_market_metrics, fractional_market_metrics, fn=compare_rank_inflation_final, doc="Ranks full-claim opportunity inflation by rank loss under fractional credit, then by extra full-claim title credit")

category_entropy = process(full_market_search, category_detail, fn=compute_category_entropy, doc="Computes Shannon entropy of fractional category-token credits within each market for the 2010-2019 period")

entropy_scored_markets = process(fractional_market_base, category_entropy, search_summary, fn=score_entropy_markets, doc="Computes opportunity scores using entropy percentile instead of simple category breadth for all fractional-credit markets")
entropy_eligible_markets = filter(entropy_scored_markets, lambda row: row["title_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps entropy-scored fractional-credit markets with at least 25 title credits")
entropy_ranked_opportunities = sort(entropy_eligible_markets, by=[("opportunity_score", "desc"), "market"])
entropy_top_five = limit(entropy_ranked_opportunities, 5)

entropy_rank_movement = process(fractional_ranked_opportunities, entropy_ranked_opportunities, fn=compare_entropy_ranks, doc="Compares simple-breadth and entropy opportunity ranks for every qualifying market and orders the largest absolute movements")

full_category_entropy = process(full_market_search, category_detail, fn=compute_full_category_entropy, doc="Computes Shannon entropy of full-claim category-token credits within each market for the 2010-2019 period")

full_entropy_scored = process(full_market_base, full_category_entropy, search_summary, fn=score_full_entropy_markets, doc="Computes full-claim opportunity scores using category entropy percentile instead of simple category breadth")
full_entropy_eligible = filter(full_entropy_scored, lambda row: row["title_credit"] >= 25, doc="Keeps full-claim entropy-scored markets with at least 25 title credits")
full_entropy_ranked = sort(full_entropy_eligible, by=[("opportunity_score", "desc"), "market"])
full_entropy_top_five = limit(full_entropy_ranked, 5)

entropy_claim_comparison = process(full_entropy_top_five, entropy_top_five, fn=compare_entropy_claims, doc="Compares full-claim and fractional-claim entropy top-five membership and reports entrants and exits")

volatility_penalized_scores = process(entropy_scored_markets, search_summary, fn=apply_volatility_penalty, doc="Subtracts 15 percent of each market's full-period search-volatility percentile from its entropy-based opportunity score")
volatility_ranked = sort(volatility_penalized_scores, by=[("penalized_score", "desc"), "market"])
volatility_top_five = limit(volatility_ranked, 5)
volatility_membership = process(volatility_top_five, entropy_top_five, fn=compare_volatility_membership, doc="Compares volatility-penalized and unpenalized entropy top-five market membership")

freshness_market_scores = process(volatility_penalized_scores, full_market_search, fn=freshness_metrics, doc="Adds fractional fresh-supply shares and a 25 percent freshness shortfall contribution to volatility-adjusted market scores")
volatility_top_eight = limit(volatility_ranked, 8)
freshness_pool = join(volatility_top_eight, freshness_market_scores, on="market", how="inner", suffix="_fresh", validate="one_to_one")

freshness_pool_scored = map(freshness_pool, lambda row: {**row, "demand_freshness_gap": row["demand_gap_fresh"] - row["fresh_supply_share"]}, doc="Adds the unweighted demand-gap minus fresh-supply-share comparison metric")
freshness_top_five = sort(freshness_pool_scored, by=[("demand_freshness_gap", "desc"), "market"])
freshness_answer = limit(freshness_top_five, 5)
freshness_report = project(freshness_answer, keep=["market", "demand_freshness_gap", "demand_gap_fresh", "fresh_supply_share", "fresh_supply_shortfall", "freshness_adjusted_score"])

freshness_market_scores_4y = process(volatility_penalized_scores, full_market_search, fn=freshness_metrics_four_year, doc="Adds four-year fractional fresh-supply shares and the unchanged freshness shortfall contribution to volatility-adjusted scores")
freshness_pool_4y = join(volatility_top_eight, freshness_market_scores_4y, on="market", how="inner", suffix="_fresh4y", validate="one_to_one")

freshness_pool_scored_4y = map(freshness_pool_4y, lambda row: {**row, "demand_freshness_gap_4y": row["demand_gap_fresh4y"] - row["fresh_supply_share_4y"]}, doc="Adds the four-year demand-gap minus fresh-supply-share comparison metric")
freshness_ranked_4y = sort(freshness_pool_scored_4y, by=[("demand_freshness_gap_4y", "desc"), "market"])
freshness_top_five_4y = limit(freshness_ranked_4y, 5)

freshness_membership_4y = process(freshness_top_five_4y, freshness_answer, fn=compare_freshness_membership_4y, doc="Compares four-year and current three-year freshness top-five membership and lists retained markets")

continuation_analysis = process(titles_with_country, freshness_market_scores, fn=continuation_adjustment, doc="Ranks the eight strict-freshness-favored markets after adding an 8 percent continuation-percentile contribution based on fractional post-2019 supply")
continuation_top_five = limit(continuation_analysis, 5)

continuation_scores_all = process(titles_with_country, freshness_market_scores, fn=build_continuation_scores_all, doc="Rebuilds continuation-adjusted opportunity scores for all search-tracked markets before the uncertain-maturity penalty")

uncertain_penalized_scores = process(continuation_scores_all, titles_with_country, fn=apply_uncertain_penalty, doc="Penalizes continuation-adjusted market scores by 10% of uncertain-maturity fractional title credit share")
pre_change_ranked = sort(uncertain_penalized_scores, by=[("continuation_adjusted_score", "desc"), "market"])
pre_change_pool = limit(pre_change_ranked, 10)
post_change_pool = join(pre_change_pool, uncertain_penalized_scores, on="market", how="inner", suffix="_penalty", validate="one_to_one")
post_change_ranked = sort(post_change_pool, by=[("updated_score", "desc"), "market"])
post_change_top_five = limit(post_change_ranked, 5)
maturity_movement_report = process(pre_change_pool, post_change_ranked, fn=maturity_movement, doc="Ranks the five greatest standing losses within the ten-market pre-change comparison pool")
updated_top_eight = limit(post_change_ranked, 8)

maturity_recovery = process(updated_top_eight, continuation_scores_all, fn=compare_maturity_recovery, doc="Measures score recovery and rank movement when reverting from uncertain-label penalties to the earlier maturity treatment within the updated top-eight pool")

structure_adult_fit = process(titles_with_country, entropy_scored_markets, fn=compute_structure_adult_fit, doc="Computes structure-aware adult maturity fit from full-catalogue fractional movie and series credits using current movie orientation")

structure_scored_markets = process(entropy_scored_markets, structure_adult_fit, fn=score_structure_aware, doc="Replaces the prior adult-fit component with structure-aware maturity fit while retaining entropy-based opportunity components")

structure_volatility_scores = process(structure_scored_markets, search_summary, fn=apply_structure_volatility, doc="Applies the existing search-volatility percentile penalty to the structure-aware opportunity score")

structure_freshness_scores = process(structure_volatility_scores, full_market_search, fn=apply_structure_freshness, doc="Adds the strict three-year fractional fresh-supply contribution to structure-aware volatility-adjusted scores")

structure_continuation_scores = process(structure_freshness_scores, titles_with_country, fn=apply_structure_continuation, doc="Adds the same 8 percent continuation-percentile contribution to structure-aware strict-freshness scores")

structure_uncertain_scores = process(structure_continuation_scores, titles_with_country, fn=apply_structure_uncertainty, doc="Applies the existing 10 percent uncertain-maturity penalty to structure-aware continuation-adjusted scores")
structure_ranked = sort(structure_uncertain_scores, by=[("updated_structure_score", "desc"), "market"])
structure_top_five = limit(structure_ranked, 5)

structure_rank_gains = process(structure_ranked, pre_change_ranked, fn=compare_structure_rank_gains, doc="Compares structure-aware and current opportunity ranks and returns the five largest positive rank gains")
longfilm_market = process(titles_with_country, fn=compute_longfilm_gap, doc="Computes fractional long-form movie shares and supply gaps from valid full-catalogue movie durations")
longfilm_pool = join(updated_top_eight, longfilm_market, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
longfilm_ranked = sort(longfilm_pool, by=[("long_form_supply_gap", "desc"), "market"])
longfilm_answer = limit(longfilm_ranked, 5)
longfilm_report = project(longfilm_answer, keep=["market", "long_form_supply_gap", "long_form_share", "valid_movie_credit", "long_form_credit"])
decade_duration_stats = process(titles_clean, fn=compute_decade_duration_stats, doc="Computes cleaned-title movie duration means and sample standard deviations by release decade")

decade_longfilm_market = process(titles_with_country, decade_duration_stats, fn=compute_decade_longfilm_market, doc="Computes fractional relative-long movie shares and supply gaps using duration standardized within release decade")
decade_longfilm_pool = join(updated_top_eight, decade_longfilm_market, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")

decade_longfilm_scores = process(decade_longfilm_pool, longfilm_market, fn=compare_longfilm_scores, doc="Compares decade-adjusted and direct long-form score contributions for the current eight-market pool")
decade_change_list = sort(decade_longfilm_scores, by=[("absolute_score_change", "desc"), "market"])
decade_change_top_five = limit(decade_change_list, 5)
decade_adjusted_ranked = sort(decade_longfilm_scores, by=[("decade_adjusted_score", "desc"), "market"])
decade_adjusted_top_five = limit(decade_adjusted_ranked, 5)
decade_change_report = project(decade_change_top_five, keep=["market", "score_change", "absolute_score_change"])
decade_top_five_report = project(decade_adjusted_top_five, keep=["market", "decade_adjusted_score"])

longfilm_market_100 = process(titles_with_country, fn=compute_longfilm_gap_100, doc="Computes fractional long-form movie shares and supply gaps from valid full-catalogue movie durations using a 100-minute cutoff")
longfilm_pool_100 = join(updated_top_eight, longfilm_market_100, on="market", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")

longfilm_scores_100 = map(longfilm_pool_100, lambda row: {**row, "direct_100_score": row["updated_score"] + 0.10 * row["long_form_supply_gap_100"]}, doc="Adds the 10% 100-minute long-form supply-gap contribution to each current market score")
longfilm_ranked_100 = sort(longfilm_scores_100, by=[("direct_100_score", "desc"), "market"])
longfilm_top_five_100 = limit(longfilm_ranked_100, 5)

longfilm_cutoff_comparison = process(longfilm_top_five_100, decade_adjusted_top_five, fn=compare_longfilm_100, doc="Compares the 100-minute direct-cutoff top five with the decade-adjusted long-form top five")

longform_sensitivity = process(decade_longfilm_scores, fn=longform_sensitivity, doc="Ranks current markets by sensitivity to replacing the decade-adjusted long-form score with the direct 110-minute long-film score")

rare_category_market = process(titles_with_country, category_detail, fn=compute_rare_category_share_fixed, doc="Computes fractional market shares of categories whose catalogue-wide title counts are below the median")

niche_adjusted_scores = process(uncertain_penalized_scores, rare_category_market, fn=add_niche_signal, doc="Adds an 8 percent rare-category gap contribution to the current uncertainty-adjusted market score")
niche_ranked = sort(niche_adjusted_scores, by=[("niche_adjusted_score", "desc"), "market"])
niche_top_five = limit(niche_ranked, 5)

niche_rank_gains = process(current_uncertainty_ranked, niche_ranked, fn=compare_niche_ranks, doc="Compares niche-adjusted and full current uncertainty-penalized ranks and returns the five largest positive rank gains")
current_uncertainty_ranked = sort(uncertain_penalized_scores, by=[("updated_score", "desc"), "market"])

niche_demand_analysis = process(niche_adjusted_scores, search_summary, rare_category_market, fn=compute_niche_demand, doc="Combines search-momentum percentile and rare-category gap into a niche-demand mismatch and adds its 6 percent score contribution")
mismatch_ranked = sort(niche_demand_analysis, by=[("niche_demand_mismatch", "desc"), "market"])
largest_niche_demand = limit(mismatch_ranked, 5)
mismatch_score_ranked = sort(niche_demand_analysis, by=[("mismatch_adjusted_score", "desc"), "market"])
mismatch_top_five = limit(mismatch_score_ranked, 5)

mismatch_membership = process(largest_niche_demand, mismatch_top_five, fn=compare_mismatch_membership, doc="Identifies which largest niche-demand mismatch markets also appear in the mismatch-adjusted opportunity top five")

niche_reward_removed_comparison = process(niche_demand_analysis, mismatch_top_five, fn=remove_niche_reward, doc="Compares mismatch-adjusted top-five membership after removing only the niche-category reward")

director_concentration_scores = process(niche_demand_analysis, titles_with_country, director_detail, fn=apply_director_concentration, doc="Applies an 8 percent penalty for each market's top director share across exploded movie director-token credit")
director_ranked = sort(director_concentration_scores, by=[("director_adjusted_score", "desc"), "market"])

director_rank_losses = process(mismatch_score_ranked, director_ranked, fn=compare_director_rank_losses, doc="Compares niche-demand and director-penalized ranks and returns the five largest standing losses")
director_top_five = limit(director_ranked, 5)
current_director_top_eight = limit(director_ranked, 8)

director_recovery = process(current_director_top_eight, niche_demand_analysis, fn=compare_director_recovery, doc="Measures score recovery and rank movement when removing the director-concentration penalty within the current top-eight pool")

later_adjustment_report = process(director_top_five, entropy_scored_markets, volatility_penalized_scores, freshness_market_scores, continuation_scores_all, uncertain_penalized_scores, structure_adult_fit, decade_longfilm_scores, niche_adjusted_scores, niche_demand_analysis, director_concentration_scores, fn=decompose_later_adjustments, doc="Reports the largest positive and negative later score adjustments for each current top-five market")

market_screen = process(director_ranked, titles_with_country, category_detail, fn=build_market_screen, doc="Screens the current market ranking using fractional catalogue coverage, valid movie duration coverage, rating availability, and category breadth")
market_screen_summary = process(market_screen, fn=summarize_market_screen, doc="Summarizes tighter-screen exclusions from the previous top ten and the surviving current-score top five")

screened_component_report = process(market_screen, entropy_scored_markets, volatility_penalized_scores, freshness_market_scores, continuation_scores_all, uncertain_penalized_scores, structure_adult_fit, decade_longfilm_scores, niche_adjusted_scores, niche_demand_analysis, director_concentration_scores, fn=screened_component_audit, doc="Reports the two largest positive score components and largest negative drag for the five strongest screen-eligible expansion markets")

screened_shortlist = project(screened_component_report, keep=["market", "largest_positive_component_1", "largest_positive_points_1", "largest_positive_component_2", "largest_positive_points_2", "largest_negative_component", "largest_negative_points"])
entropy_screened = join(entropy_scored_markets, market_screen, on="market", how="inner", suffix="_screen", validate="one_to_one")
entropy_screened_eligible = filter(entropy_screened, lambda row: row["screen_eligible"] is True, doc="Keeps markets that pass the current tighter data-coverage screen")
entropy_screened_ranked = sort(entropy_screened_eligible, by=[("opportunity_score", "desc"), "market"])
entropy_screened_top_five = limit(entropy_screened_ranked, 5)

entropy_screen_comparison = process(entropy_screened_top_five, screened_shortlist, fn=compare_entropy_screened_shortlist, doc="Compares the earlier entropy-score screened top five with the current practical shortlist")

full_claim_latest_screen = process(full_market_base, full_category_entropy, search_summary, structure_adult_fit, volatility_penalized_scores, freshness_market_scores, continuation_scores_all, uncertain_penalized_scores, decade_longfilm_scores, niche_adjusted_scores, niche_demand_analysis, director_concentration_scores, market_screen, screened_shortlist, fn=compare_full_claim_latest, doc="Ranks screen-eligible markets under temporary full-claim core components with fractional latest maturity and later adjustments held fixed")

regional_volatility_screen = process(market_screen, volatility_penalized_scores, screened_shortlist, fn=regional_sensitivity, doc="Excludes Canada, Mexico, and the United States and applies a second volatility penalty to the tighter-screened market ranking")

definitions.source: times_preview = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv", preview=5)
times_raw = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv")
times_2016 = filter(times_raw, lambda row: row["year"] == 2016, doc="Keeps only Times Higher Education records from 2016")
times_2016_clean = map(times_2016, clean_times_scores, doc="Cleans THE score fields by converting valid values to numbers and retaining missing or unparseable values as missing")
times_2016_scored = map(times_2016_clean, add_formula_score, doc="Adds the THE formula-calculated total score when all five component scores are present")

total_score_comparison = process(times_2016_scored, fn=compare_total_scores, doc="Reports Pearson correlation, two-sided p-value, complete score pairs, and the count of non-missing official total scores")
times_2016_filled = map(times_2016_scored, fill_total_score, doc="Fills missing official total scores with the THE formula score when available")

times_2016_missing_flag = map(times_2016_filled, final_missing_indicators, doc="Flags missing values in the cleaned 2016 record after replacing the official total score with the formula score when needed")
missing_summary = aggregate(times_2016_missing_flag, remaining_missing_total=sum("missing_filled_total"), universities_with_any_missing=sum("has_any_missing"), universities=count())
numeric_ranking = map(times_2016_filled, numeric_ranking_row, doc="Keeps the ten requested ranking variables as numeric values and leaves missing or unparseable values missing")

ranking_correlation_extremes = process(numeric_ranking, fn=pairwise_ranking_correlations, doc="Reports the five strongest and five weakest pairwise-complete Pearson correlations among the ten numeric ranking variables")

mahalanobis_distances = process(times_2016_filled, numeric_ranking, fn=mahalanobis_rows, doc="Reports each university's squared Mahalanobis distance from the ten-variable ranking profile using pairwise-complete moments and a pseudo-inverse")
mahalanobis_ranked = sort(mahalanobis_distances, by=[("mahalanobis_squared", "desc"), "university_name"])
mahalanobis_top5 = limit(mahalanobis_ranked, 5)
times_with_distance = join(times_2016_filled, mahalanobis_distances, on="university_name", how="left", suffix="_mahal", validate="one_to_one")
cleaning_numeric = map(times_with_distance, add_cleaning_numeric_fields, doc="Adds numeric student count and female-side percentage from the female-to-male field for outlier screening")
nonmultivariate_kept = filter(cleaning_numeric, keep_nonmultivariate, doc="Keeps universities with missing or sub-threshold squared Mahalanobis distance")

complete_univariate_fields = filter(nonmultivariate_kept, lambda row: row["numeric_students"] is not None and row["numeric_female_to_male_ratio"] is not None, doc="Keeps universities with non-missing student count and female-to-male ratio")

univariate_cleaned = filter(complete_univariate_fields, lambda row: row["numeric_students"] < 90000 and row["numeric_female_to_male_ratio"] > 5, doc="Removes universities with at least 90000 students or female-to-male ratio of 5 or lower")
cleaning_summary = process(times_2016_filled, univariate_cleaned, fn=summarize_cleaning, doc="Compares total-score mean and sample standard deviation before and after the staged outlier cleaning")

student_distribution = process(univariate_cleaned, fn=summarize_student_distribution, doc="Reports mean, median, sample standard deviation, minimum, maximum, quartiles, and interquartile range of non-missing student counts in the cleaned universities")
cleaned_numeric_ranking = map(univariate_cleaned, cleaned_numeric_row, doc="Keeps the ten ranking variables as numeric values for universities surviving the staged outlier removal")

correlation_change = process(numeric_ranking, cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=compare_correlation_change, doc="Compares the five strongest pre-cleaning pairwise correlations with their post-cleaning correlations and ranks absolute changes")
teaching_research_correlation = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=teaching_research_summary, doc="Reports the Pearson correlation between teaching and research scores in the cleaned universities")
cleaned_university_scores = map(univariate_cleaned, university_scores, doc="Keeps university names and numeric teaching, research, and filled total scores for cleaned universities")
teaching_ranked = sort(cleaned_university_scores, by=[("teaching_score", "desc"), "university_name"])
top5_teaching = limit(teaching_ranked, 5)

international_core_correlations = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=international_core_correlations, doc="Reports pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and two-sided p-values between international student percentage and teaching, research, and citations scores")

research_international_model = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=fit_research_international, doc="Fits a simple linear regression predicting research score from international student percentage on complete cleaned pairs")

research_residuals = process(univariate_cleaned, cleaned_numeric_ranking, research_international_model, fn=make_research_residuals, doc="Reports actual, predicted, and residual research scores for cleaned universities with observed international student percentage")
research_residuals_ranked = sort(research_residuals, by=[("residual", "desc"), "university_name"])
research_top3_positive_residuals = limit(research_residuals_ranked, 3)
cleaned_total_ranked = sort(cleaned_university_scores, by=[("total_score", "desc"), "university_name"])
cleaned_top10_total = limit(cleaned_total_ranked, 10)
cleaned_top10_context = project(univariate_cleaned, keep=["university_name", "international_student_percentage"])
cleaned_top10_with_context = join(cleaned_top10_total, cleaned_top10_context, on="university_name", how="left", validate="one_to_one")

top10_research_predictions = process(cleaned_top10_with_context, research_international_model, fn=predict_top10_research, doc="Predicts research scores for the ten highest-total-score cleaned universities and reports their residuals from the fitted international-student model")
top10_research_ranked = sort(top10_research_predictions, by=[("residual", "desc"), "university_name"])
top3_top10_research_outperformance = limit(top10_research_ranked, 3)

student_international_corr = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=student_international_correlation, doc="Reports the pairwise-complete Pearson correlation between student count and international student percentage in the cleaned universities")
student_listing = map(univariate_cleaned, student_listing_row, doc="Keeps cleaned universities with numeric student count, international student percentage, and research score")
largest_students_ranked = sort(student_listing, by=[("number_of_students", "desc"), "university_name"])
largest_students = limit(largest_students_ranked, 5)
smallest_students_ranked = sort(student_listing, by=[("number_of_students", "asc"), "university_name"])
smallest_students = limit(smallest_students_ranked, 5)
subset_numeric = map(univariate_cleaned, subset_numeric_row, doc="Keeps numeric international-student percentage, student count, and research score for cleaned universities")
subset_medians = aggregate(subset_numeric, median_international=median("international_student_percentage"), median_students=median("number_of_students"))

small_high_international = filter(subset_numeric, lambda row: row["international_student_percentage"] is not None and row["number_of_students"] is not None and row["international_student_percentage"] > 10 and row["number_of_students"] < 19653, doc="Keeps cleaned universities above the median international-student percentage and below the median student count")

subset_research_summary = process(small_high_international, subset_numeric, fn=summarize_subset_research, doc="Compares the mean research score for the small highly international subset with the overall cleaned mean using non-missing research scores")
small_high_international_ranked = sort(small_high_international, by=[("research_score", "desc"), "university_name"])
small_high_international_top5 = limit(small_high_international_ranked, 5)
female_income_stem = map(univariate_cleaned, female_income_stem_row, doc="Adds numeric female-to-male ratio, income, and a case-insensitive STEM name indicator")
gender_income_summary = process(female_income_stem, fn=summarize_gender_income, doc="Reports simple and STEM-adjusted female-to-male ratio versus income correlations and full cleaned STEM counts")
stem_group_metrics = map(univariate_cleaned, stem_group_row, doc="Assigns cleaned universities to STEM or non-STEM groups and keeps numeric ranking dimensions")

stem_group_means = aggregate(stem_group_metrics, by=["group"], teaching_mean=mean("teaching"), research_mean=mean("research"), citations_mean=mean("citations"), income_mean=mean("income"), international_student_percentage_mean=mean("international_student_percentage"), group_count=count())
stem_mean_comparison = process(stem_group_means, fn=compare_stem_means, doc="Compares STEM and non-STEM means, differences, and higher groups for each ranking dimension")

citations_factor_correlations = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=citations_factor_correlations, doc="Reports pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and two-sided p-values between citations score and four cleaned university characteristics")

stem_citations_international = process(stem_group_metrics, fn=compare_group_citations, doc="Compares pairwise-complete internationalization-citations correlations for STEM and non-STEM groups with the full cleaned-dataset correlation")

citations_interaction_model = process(cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=fit_citations_interaction, doc="Fits citations score on international student percentage, female-male ratio, and their interaction for complete cleaned cases")

research_quality_top5 = process(univariate_cleaned, fn=build_research_quality, doc="Ranks cleaned universities by the average of percentile ranks for citations, research, and international-student percentage and flags overlap with the official-total top five")
research_quality_overlap = process(research_quality_top5, fn=summarize_research_quality_overlap, doc="Counts composite-index top-five universities that also occur in the official-total top five")

gender_balanced_complete = filter(univariate_cleaned, keep_gender_balanced_complete, doc="Keeps gender-balanced universities with female-side percentages from 45 through 55 and complete citation, research, internationalization, and gender fields")

gender_balanced_residuals = process(gender_balanced_complete, citations_interaction_model, research_international_model, fn=compute_gender_balanced_residuals, doc="Computes citation-model and research-model residuals for complete gender-balanced universities")
gender_balanced_residuals_ranked = sort(gender_balanced_residuals, by=[("citations_residual", "desc"), "university_name"])
gender_balanced_top3 = limit(gender_balanced_residuals_ranked, 3)

multivariate_outliers = filter(times_with_distance, lambda row: row["mahalanobis_squared"] is not None and row["mahalanobis_squared"] >= 25, doc="Keeps universities identified as multivariate outliers by squared Mahalanobis distance of at least 25")
outlier_numeric = map(multivariate_outliers, outlier_numeric_row, doc="Keeps numeric scores and university characteristics for multivariate outliers")

outlier_comparison = process(outlier_numeric, cleaned_numeric_ranking, fn=summarize_outlier_comparison_fixed, doc="Compares multivariate-outlier score means and citation correlations with internationalization, staffing, and gender ratio against the full cleaned dataset")

statements: eligible_titles = filter(clean_titles, lambda row: row['added_year'] is not None and 2010 <= row['added_year'] <= 2019, doc='Keeps titles added to Netflix from 2010 through 2019')

market_categories = distinct(assigned_categories, columns=['token', 'show_id'], keep='first')
genre_counts = aggregate(market_categories, by=['token'], genre_count=count_distinct('token'))

market_with_search = join(market_base, search_markets, on=[('token', 'market')], how='inner', validate='many_to_one')
market_with_genres = join(market_with_search, genre_counts, on='token', how='left', validate='one_to_one')

def score_full_claim(markets):
    import pandas as pd
    x=markets.copy()
    n=len(x)
    def pct(s): return s.rank(method='average', ascending=True)/n*100.0
    x['content_credit_pct']=pct(x['title_credit'])
    x['search_momentum_pct']=pct(x['search_momentum'])
    x['genre_breadth_pct']=pct(x['genre_count'])
    x['demand_gap']=x['search_momentum_pct']-x['content_credit_pct']
    x['delayed_supply']=100.0-x['delayed_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['adult_maturity_fit']=x['adult_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['movie_orientation']=x['movie_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['opportunity_score']=0.35*x['demand_gap']+0.25*x['delayed_supply']+0.20*x['adult_maturity_fit']+0.10*x['movie_orientation']+0.10*x['genre_breadth_pct']
    x=x.loc[x['title_credit']>=25].copy().sort_values(['opportunity_score','market'],ascending=[False,True]).head(5)
    return x[['market','opportunity_score','demand_gap','delayed_supply','adult_maturity_fit','movie_orientation','genre_count','title_credit']].reset_index(drop=True)

def score_full_claim(markets):
    import pandas as pd
    x=markets.copy()
    n=len(x)
    def pct(s): return s.rank(method='average', ascending=True)/n*100.0
    x['content_credit_pct']=pct(x['title_credit'])
    x['search_momentum_pct']=pct(x['search_momentum'])
    x['genre_breadth_pct']=pct(x['genre_count'])
    x['demand_gap']=x['search_momentum_pct']-x['content_credit_pct']
    x['delayed_supply']=100.0-x['delayed_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['adult_maturity_fit']=x['adult_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['movie_orientation']=x['movie_credit']/x['title_credit']*100.0
    x['opportunity_score']=0.35*x['demand_gap']+0.25*x['delayed_supply']+0.20*x['adult_maturity_fit']+0.10*x['movie_orientation']+0.10*x['genre_breadth_pct']
    x=x.loc[x['title_credit']>=25].copy().sort_values(['opportunity_score','market'],ascending=[False,True]).head(5)
    return x[['market','opportunity_score','demand_gap','delayed_supply','adult_maturity_fit','movie_orientation','genre_count','title_credit']].reset_index(drop=True)

def score_entropy_and_compare(entropy_markets, previous):
    import pandas as pd
    x=entropy_markets.copy(); n=len(x)
    def pct(s): return s.rank(method="average", ascending=True)/n*100.0
    x["content_credit_pct"]=pct(x["title_credit"])
    x["search_momentum_pct"]=pct(x["search_momentum"])
    x["entropy_pct"]=pct(x["category_entropy"])
    x["demand_gap"]=x["search_momentum_pct"]-x["content_credit_pct"]
    x["delayed_supply"]=100.0-x["delayed_credit"]/x["title_credit"]*100.0
    x["adult_maturity_fit"]=x["adult_credit"]/x["title_credit"]*100.0
    x["movie_orientation"]=x["movie_credit"]/x["title_credit"]*100.0
    x["opportunity_score"]=0.35*x["demand_gap"]+0.25*x["delayed_supply"]+0.20*x["adult_maturity_fit"]+0.10*x["movie_orientation"]+0.10*x["entropy_pct"]
    x=x.loc[x["title_credit"]>=25].sort_values(["opportunity_score","market"],ascending=[False,True]).reset_index(drop=True)
    x["entropy_rank"]=x.index+1
    p=previous[["market","fractional_rank"]]
    y=x.merge(p,on="market",how="left")
    y["rank_change"]=y["fractional_rank"]-y["entropy_rank"]
    movers=y.assign(abs_rank_movement=y["rank_change"].abs()).sort_values(["abs_rank_movement","market"],ascending=[False,True]).head(5)
    top=y.head(5)
    rows=[]
    for _,r in movers.iterrows(): rows.append({"list_type":"largest_absolute_rank_movement","market":r["market"],"rank_change":int(r["rank_change"]),"previous_rank":int(r["fractional_rank"]),"entropy_rank":int(r["entropy_rank"])})
    for _,r in top.iterrows(): rows.append({"list_type":"new_top5","market":r["market"],"rank_change":int(r["rank_change"]),"previous_rank":int(r["fractional_rank"]),"entropy_rank":int(r["entropy_rank"])})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
