definitions.source: input_files = process(fn=list_inputs, doc="Lists the available Netflix catalogue and search-interest input files")
catalogue_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv", preview=5)
search_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/australia.csv", preview=8)
combined_search_preview = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/multiTimeline.csv", preview=8)

clean_titles = process(fn=clean_catalogue_fixed, doc="Standardizes Netflix titles, parses mixed catalogue-addition dates row by row, and derives duration, seasons, release decade, and release-to-add lag")
country_detail = process(clean_titles, fn=lambda t: detail_tokens(t,'country'), doc="One row per title-country token with listed order, country count, and equal fractional credit")
category_detail = process(clean_titles, fn=lambda t: detail_tokens(t,'listed_in'), doc="One row per title-listed-category token in listed order")
director_detail = process(clean_titles, fn=lambda t: detail_tokens(t,'director'), doc="One row per title-director token in listed order")
cast_detail = process(clean_titles, fn=lambda t: detail_tokens(t,'cast'), doc="One row per title-cast token in listed order")
search_interest_summary = process(fn=search_summary, doc="Summarizes weekly country search interest for 2015, 2019, momentum, and full-period sample volatility")

data_quality_report = process(clean_titles, country_detail, category_detail, director_detail, cast_detail, search_interest_summary, fn=quality_report, doc="Reports working-table row counts, search-market coverage, and missingness in standardized title and search-summary fields")
eligible_titles = filter(clean_titles, lambda row: row["added_year"] is not None and 2010 <= row["added_year"] <= 2019, doc="Keeps titles added to Netflix from 2010 through 2019")
sole_country_detail = filter(country_detail, lambda row: row["country_count"] == 1, doc="Keeps only titles whose listed country field contains exactly one country")
assigned_titles = join(sole_country_detail, eligible_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

flagged_assigned = map(assigned_titles, lambda row: {**row, "delayed_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["added_year"] in (2018, 2019) else 0.0, "adult_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["rating_group"] == "adult" else 0.0, "movie_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["type"] == "Movie" else 0.0}, doc="Adds title-credit flags for delayed supply, adult maturity, and movie orientation")

search_markets = map(search_interest_summary, lambda row: {**row, "market": "United States" if row["country"] == "multiTimeline" else {"south_korea":"South Korea","hongkong":"Hong Kong","uk":"United Kingdom"}.get(row["country"], row["country"].title())}, doc="Normalizes search-summary file labels to catalogue market names")

market_base = aggregate(flagged_assigned, by=["token"], title_credit=sum("fractional_credit"), delayed_credit=sum("delayed_flag"), adult_credit=sum("adult_flag"), movie_credit=sum("movie_flag"), title_count=count())
assigned_categories = join(category_detail, eligible_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")
category_country = join(assigned_categories, sole_country_detail, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_country", validate="many_to_one")
market_categories = distinct(category_country, columns=["token", "show_id"], keep="first")
genre_counts = aggregate(market_category_pairs, by=["market"], genre_count=count_distinct("category"))
market_with_search = join(market_base_keyed, search_markets_keyed2, on="market_key", how="inner", suffix="_search", validate="many_to_one")
market_with_genres = join(market_with_search, genre_counts, on="market", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
market_base_named = project(market_base, rename={"token":"market"})

search_markets_keyed = map(search_interest_summary, lambda row: {**row, "market": {"multiTimeline":"United States","south_korea":"South Korea","hongkong":"Hong Kong","uk":"United Kingdom"}.get(row["country"], row["country"].replace("_"," ").title())}, doc="Creates catalogue-style market names from search-summary file names")
search_markets_keyed2 = map(search_markets_keyed, lambda row: {**row, "market_key": row["market"].lower()}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key for case-insensitive market matching")
market_base_keyed = map(market_base_named, lambda row: {**row, "market_key": row["market"].lower()}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key to single-country title credits")

category_country_market = map(category_country, lambda row: {"market": row["token_country"], "show_id": row["show_id"], "category": row["token"]}, doc="Keeps the sole-country market and category for each eligible title")
market_category_pairs = distinct(category_country_market, columns=["market","show_id","category"], keep="first")

opportunity_top5 = process(market_with_genres, fn=score_markets, doc="Ranks search-tracked markets by weighted early opportunity signal after computing all percentile components and applying the minimum title-credit screen")
opportunity_answer = project(opportunity_top5, keep=["market","opportunity_score","demand_gap","delayed_supply","adult_maturity_fit","movie_orientation","genre_count"])
dominant_score_components = process(opportunity_top5, fn=dominant_components, doc="Identifies the largest weighted opportunity-score contribution for each first-scan market")
full_country_titles = join(country_detail, eligible_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

full_flagged_assigned = map(full_country_titles, lambda row: {**row, "full_credit": 1.0, "delayed_flag": 1.0 if row["added_year"] in (2018, 2019) else 0.0, "adult_flag": 1.0 if row["rating_group"] == "adult" else 0.0, "movie_flag": 1.0 if row["type"] == "Movie" else 0.0}, doc="Adds full title-claim flags for every listed country, including delayed supply, adult maturity, and movie orientation")

full_market_base = aggregate(full_flagged_assigned, by=["token"], title_credit=sum("full_credit"), delayed_credit=sum("delayed_flag"), adult_credit=sum("adult_flag"), movie_credit=sum("movie_flag"), title_count=count())
full_market_named = project(full_market_base, rename={"token":"market"})
full_market_keyed = map(full_market_named, lambda row: {**row, "market_key": row["market"].lower()}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key to full-claim title credits")
full_market_with_search = join(full_market_keyed, search_markets_keyed2, on="market_key", how="inner", suffix="_search", validate="many_to_one")
full_category_join = join(full_category_eligible, country_detail, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_country", validate="many_to_many")

full_category_market = map(full_category_join, lambda row: {"market": row["token_country"], "show_id": row["show_id"], "category": row["token"]}, doc="Keeps every listed country and category pairing for full-claim breadth")
full_category_pairs = distinct(full_category_market, columns=["market","show_id","category"], keep="first")
full_genre_counts = aggregate(full_category_pairs, by=["market"], genre_count=count_distinct("category"))
full_market_with_genres = join(full_market_with_search, full_genre_counts, on="market", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
full_category_eligible = join(category_detail, eligible_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")

full_opportunity_top5 = process(full_market_with_genres, fn=score_full_claim, doc="Ranks full-claim search-tracked markets by the same weighted opportunity signal after the minimum title-credit screen")

full_claim_comparison = process(full_opportunity_top5, opportunity_top5, full_market_with_search, market_with_search, fn=compare_full_claim, doc="Reports full-claim top-five entrants, departing conservative leaders, and largest title-credit gains among qualifying markets")

fractional_flagged_assigned = map(full_country_titles, lambda row: {**row, "delayed_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["added_year"] in (2018, 2019) else 0.0, "adult_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["rating_group"] == "adult" else 0.0, "movie_flag": row["fractional_credit"] if row["type"] == "Movie" else 0.0}, doc="Adds fractional title-credit flags for delayed supply, adult maturity, and movie orientation")

fractional_market_base = aggregate(fractional_flagged_assigned, by=["token"], title_credit=sum("fractional_credit"), delayed_credit=sum("delayed_flag"), adult_credit=sum("adult_flag"), movie_credit=sum("movie_flag"), title_count=count())
fractional_market_named = project(fractional_market_base, rename={"token":"market"})
fractional_market_keyed = map(fractional_market_named, lambda row: {**row, "market_key": row["market"].lower()}, doc="Adds a lowercase market key to fractional country credits")
fractional_market_with_search = join(fractional_market_keyed, search_markets_keyed2, on="market_key", how="inner", suffix="_search", validate="many_to_one")
fractional_market_with_genres = join(fractional_market_with_search, full_genre_counts, on="market", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
fractional_opportunity_ranked = process(fractional_market_with_genres, fn=score_fractional_all, doc="Ranks search-tracked markets by the weighted opportunity signal using fractional country credit")
full_opportunity_ranked = process(full_market_with_genres, fn=rank_full_all, doc="Ranks all qualifying search-tracked markets by the weighted opportunity signal using full country claims")
fractional_top5 = limit(fractional_opportunity_ranked, 5)

inflated_markets = process(full_opportunity_ranked, fractional_opportunity_ranked, fn=compare_rank_inflation, doc="Reports markets whose full-claim opportunity standing is most inflated relative to fractional country credit")
fractional_answer = project(fractional_top5, keep=['market','opportunity_score','demand_gap','delayed_supply','adult_maturity_fit','movie_orientation','genre_count'])

fractional_leader_full_claim_status = process(fractional_top5, full_opportunity_ranked, fn=compare_leader_status, doc="Checks whether each fractional-credit opportunity leader remains in the corrected full-claim top five")
eligible_category_entropy = join(category_detail, eligible_titles, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_title", validate="many_to_one")
category_country_entropy = join(eligible_category_entropy, country_detail, on="show_id", how="inner", suffix="_country", validate="many_to_many")

category_credit_rows = map(category_country_entropy, lambda row: {"market": row["token_country"], "show_id": row["show_id"], "category": row["token"], "category_credit": row["fractional_credit"]}, doc="Assigns each eligible title-category token its fractional country credit in each listed market")
market_category_credit = aggregate(category_credit_rows, by=["market","category"], category_credit=sum("category_credit"))
market_category_totals = aggregate(market_category_credit, by=["market"], total_category_credit=sum("category_credit"))
market_category_entropy = process(market_category_credit, market_category_totals, fn=entropy_table, doc="Computes Shannon entropy of fractional category-token shares within each market")
fractional_market_entropy = join(fractional_market_with_search, market_category_entropy, on="market", how="left", validate="one_to_one")

entropy_rank_movement = process(fractional_market_entropy, fractional_opportunity_ranked, fn=score_entropy_and_compare, doc="Ranks fractional-credit markets with entropy breadth and reports rank movement versus the simple-breadth scan")
full_entropy_category_credit = aggregate(full_category_market, by=["market","category"], category_credit=count())
full_entropy_category_totals = aggregate(full_entropy_category_credit, by=["market"], total_category_credit=sum("category_credit"))
fractional_entropy_ranked = process(fractional_market_entropy, fn=rank_entropy_markets, doc="Ranks fractional-credit markets using entropy breadth")

full_market_category_entropy = process(full_entropy_category_credit, full_entropy_category_totals, fn=full_entropy_table, doc="Computes Shannon entropy of full-claim category-token shares within each market")
full_market_entropy = join(full_market_with_search, full_market_category_entropy, on="market", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
full_entropy_ranked = process(full_market_entropy, fn=rank_entropy_markets, doc="Ranks full-claim markets using entropy breadth")
entropy_top5_comparison = process(fractional_entropy_ranked, full_entropy_ranked, fn=compare_entropy_top5, doc="Compares fractional and full-claim entropy-based top-five membership")

volatility_penalty_comparison = process(fractional_market_entropy, fractional_entropy_ranked, fn=score_with_volatility_penalty, doc="Compares fractional entropy opportunity top-five membership after subtracting 15 percent of search-volatility percentile")
freshness_by_market = process(fresh_country_titles, fn=freshness_by_market_fixed, doc="Computes each market's fractional fresh-supply share among titles with valid release-to-add lag")

freshness_demand_gap_top5 = process(fractional_market_entropy, freshness_by_market, fn=freshness_opportunity_fixed, doc="Ranks the eight volatility-adjusted leading markets by demand gap relative to fresh-supply share")

top10_issues_2021 = join(top10_languages, language_issues_2021, on="name", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
top10_issues_2021_ranked = sort(top10_issues_2021, by=[("issues_2021", "desc"), "name"])

share_2021_den = aggregate(yearly_share_2021, total_2021=sum("total_issues"))

positive_rounded = map(positive_result, share_2011=float64(lambda row: round(row["share_2011"], 3)), share_2021=float64(lambda row: round(row["share_2021"], 3)), change=float64(lambda row: round(row["change"], 3)))

negative_rounded = map(negative_result, share_2011=float64(lambda row: round(row["share_2011"], 3)), share_2021=float64(lambda row: round(row["share_2021"], 3)), change=float64(lambda row: round(row["change"], 3)))
language_yearly = aggregate(issues_pre2022, by=["name", "year"], annual_issues=sum("count"))

second_half_rows = filter(language_yearly, lambda row: row["year"] >= 2016 and row["year"] <= 2021)

def top10_predicted_research(top10, cleaned):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    fit = cleaned[["international_student_percentage", "research"]].dropna()
    x = fit["international_student_percentage"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    y = fit["research"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
    out = top10[["university_name", "total_score", "international_student_percentage", "research"]].copy()
    out = out.dropna(subset=["international_student_percentage", "research", "total_score"])
    out["predicted_research"] = intercept + slope * out["international_student_percentage"].astype(float)
    out["residual"] = out["research"].astype(float) - out["predicted_research"]
    out = out.sort_values(["residual", "university_name"], ascending=[False, True]).head(3)
    return out.reset_index(drop=True)

def add_mahalanobis_current(df):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    cols = ["teaching", "international", "research", "citations", "income", "total_score", "number_of_students", "student_staff_ratio", "international_student_percentage", "female_to_male_ratio"]
    means = df[cols].mean()
    cov = df[cols].cov()
    inv_cov = np.linalg.pinv(cov.to_numpy())
    complete = df[cols].notna().all(axis=1)
    distances = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index, dtype=float)
    x = df.loc[complete, cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    centered = x - means.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    distances.loc[complete] = np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", centered, inv_cov, centered)
    out = df.copy()
    out["mahalanobis_squared"] = distances
    return out

definitions.source: times_raw = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv", preview=5)
times = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv")
times_clean = cast(times, teaching=float64, international=float64, research=float64, citations=float64, income=float64, total_score=float64, year=int64, errors="null")
times_2016 = filter(times_clean, lambda row: row["year"] == 2016)

times_with_formula = map(times_2016, formula_total=float64(lambda row: None if any(row[c] is None for c in ["teaching", "research", "citations", "international", "income"]) else row["teaching"] * 0.3 + row["research"] * 0.3 + row["citations"] * 0.3 + row["international"] * 0.075 + row["income"] * 0.025))
valid_pairs = filter(times_with_formula, lambda row: row["total_score"] is not None and row["formula_total"] is not None)
official_count = aggregate(times_2016, nonmissing_official=count("total_score"))
correlation = process(valid_pairs, fn=pearson_stats)
total_filled = map(times_with_formula, total_score_filled=float64(lambda row: row["total_score"] if row["total_score"] is not None else row["formula_total"]))
missing_total = filter(total_filled, lambda row: row["total_score_filled"] is None)
missing_any_marked = map(total_filled, missing_any=int64(lambda row: 1 if any(value is None for value in row.values()) else 0))
missing_any_summary = aggregate(missing_any_marked, universities_with_any_missing=sum("missing_any"), universities_total=count())
missing_total_summary = aggregate(missing_total, universities_with_missing_total=count())
filled_scores = map(times_with_formula, total_score=float64(lambda row: row["total_score"] if row["total_score"] is not None else row["formula_total"]))
filled_missing_any_marked = map(filled_scores, missing_any=int64(lambda row: 1 if any(value is None for value in row.values()) else 0))
filled_missing_any_summary = aggregate(filled_missing_any_marked, universities_with_any_missing=sum("missing_any"), universities_total=count())
filled_missing_total = filter(filled_scores, lambda row: row["total_score"] is None)
filled_missing_total_summary = aggregate(filled_missing_total, universities_with_missing_total=count())

numeric_vars = map(filled_scores, **{"number_of_students": float64(parse_num_students), "international_student_percentage": float64(parse_percent), "female_to_male_ratio": float64(parse_female_percentage)})
pairwise_top_bottom = process(numeric_vars, fn=pairwise_rankings)

univariate_ready = filter(multivariate_kept, lambda row: row["number_of_students"] is not None and row["female_to_male_ratio"] is not None)
cleaned = filter(univariate_ready, lambda row: row["number_of_students"] < 90000 and row["female_to_male_ratio"] > 5)
mean_before = aggregate(numeric_vars, total_score_mean=mean("total_score"), total_score_sd=stddev("total_score"), n=count("total_score"))
mean_after = aggregate(cleaned, total_score_mean=mean("total_score"), total_score_sd=stddev("total_score"), n=count("total_score"))
cleaned_count = aggregate(cleaned, universities_remaining=count())
ratio_stats = aggregate(numeric_vars, max_ratio=max("female_to_male_ratio"), min_ratio=min("female_to_male_ratio"), mean_ratio=mean("female_to_male_ratio"), n=count("female_to_male_ratio"))
student_stats = aggregate(numeric_vars, max_students=max("number_of_students"), min_students=min("number_of_students"), n=count("number_of_students"))
cleaned_student_distribution = process(cleaned, fn=student_distribution)
ratio_samples = project(times_2016, keep=["university_name","female_male_ratio","num_students"])
ratio_sample20 = limit(ratio_samples, 20)
correlation_changes = process(numeric_vars, cleaned, fn=compare_top_pairs)
cleaned_teaching_research_corr = process(cleaned, fn=teaching_research_corr)

stem_group_means = aggregate(stem_classified, by=["stem_group"], teaching_mean=mean("teaching"), research_mean=mean("research"), citations_mean=mean("citations"), income_mean=mean("income"), international_student_percentage_mean=mean("international_student_percentage"), n=count())
group_comparison = process(stem_group_means, fn=compare_groups)
citation_factor_correlations = process(cleaned, fn=citation_factor_correlations)

definitions.source: times_preview = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv", preview=5)
times_raw = scan("data/longds/education/world_university_rankings/task2/data/world-university-rankings/timesData.csv", all_text=True)
times_2016_raw = filter(times_raw, lambda row: row["year"] == "2016", doc="Keeps only Times Higher Education records from 2016")
times_2016_clean = map(times_2016_raw, clean_times_scores, doc="Keeps university score fields and converts numeric text to floats while preserving missing or unparseable values")
times_2016_scored = map(times_2016_clean, add_formula, doc="Adds the THE formula-calculated total score when all five component scores are present")
official_score_count = aggregate(times_2016_scored, nonmissing_official=count("total_score"))

times_both_scores = filter(times_2016_scored, lambda row: row["total_score"] is not None and row["formula_total_score"] is not None, doc="Keeps 2016 universities with both official and formula-calculated total scores")
times_score_correlation = process(times_both_scores, fn=pearson_comparison, doc="Reports Pearson correlation and two-sided p-value between official and formula-calculated total scores")
times_2016_filled = map(times_2016_scored, fill_total, doc="Fills missing official total scores with the THE formula when all five component scores are present")
missing_total_count = aggregate(times_2016_filled, missing_filled_total=count("total_score_filled"))

missing_summary = process(times_2016_raw, times_2016_filled, fn=summarize_missing, doc="Counts 2016 universities with a missing filled total score and with any missing value across the cleaned fields")

correlation_extremes = process(times_2016_raw, times_2016_filled, fn=rank_correlations, doc="Reports the five strongest and five weakest pairwise-complete Pearson correlations among the ten requested 2016 ranking variables")

mahalanobis_top5 = process(times_2016_raw, times_2016_filled, fn=top_mahalanobis, doc="Reports the five complete-case universities with the highest squared Mahalanobis distances across the ten numeric ranking variables")

mahalanobis_all = process(times_2016_raw, times_2016_filled, fn=build_mahalanobis_table, doc="Adds squared Mahalanobis distances using pairwise-complete means and covariance across the ten cleaned numeric ranking variables")

multivariate_kept = filter(mahalanobis_all, lambda row: row["mahalanobis_squared"] is None or row["mahalanobis_squared"] < 25, doc="Keeps universities with missing or sub-threshold squared Mahalanobis distance")

univariate_complete = filter(multivariate_kept, lambda row: row["num_students"] is not None and row["female_male_ratio"] is not None, doc="Keeps multivariate-screened universities with non-missing student count and female-to-male ratio")

cleaned_universities = filter(univariate_complete, lambda row: row["num_students"] < 90000 and row["female_male_ratio"] > 5, doc="Removes universities with at least 90000 students or female-to-male ratio at most 5")
before_total_summary = aggregate(times_2016_filled, total_mean=mean("total_score_filled"), total_sd=stddev("total_score_filled"), n=count("total_score_filled"))
after_total_summary = aggregate(cleaned_universities, total_mean=mean("total_score_filled"), total_sd=stddev("total_score_filled"), n=count("total_score_filled"))
cleaned_count = aggregate(cleaned_universities, universities_remaining=count())

student_distribution_stats = process(cleaned_universities, fn=student_distribution, doc="Reports mean, median, sample standard deviation, minimum, maximum, quartiles, and interquartile range of non-missing student counts in the cleaned universities")

outlier_correlation_changes = process(mahalanobis_all, cleaned_universities, fn=compare_top_correlations, doc="Reports how the five strongest pre-cleaning pairwise correlations change after outlier removal")

cleaned_teaching_research_corr = process(cleaned_universities, fn=teaching_research_corr, doc="Reports the Pearson correlation between teaching and research scores using pairwise-complete cleaned universities")
top_teaching_sorted = sort(cleaned_universities, by=[("teaching", "desc"), "university_name"])
top5_teaching = limit(top_teaching_sorted, 5)
top5_teaching_report = project(top5_teaching, keep=["university_name", "teaching", "research", "total_score_filled"])

international_score_correlations = process(cleaned_universities, fn=international_score_correlations, doc="Reports pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and two-sided p-values between international student percentage and each core ranking score")

research_regression = process(cleaned_universities, fn=regression_residuals, doc="Reports the research-on-international-student-percentage linear regression and the three universities with the largest positive residuals")

top10_research_outperformers = process(cleaned_universities, research_regression, fn=top_total_research_residuals, doc="Reports the three top-total-score universities with the largest positive research residuals from the fitted international-student regression")

student_international_correlation = process(cleaned_universities, fn=students_international_corr, doc="Reports the pairwise-complete Pearson correlation between number of students and international student percentage")
students_desc = sort(cleaned_universities, by=[("num_students", "desc"), "university_name"])
largest_students = limit(students_desc, 5)
largest_students_report = project(largest_students, keep=["university_name", "num_students", "international_students", "research"])
students_asc = sort(cleaned_universities, by=["num_students", "university_name"])
smallest_students = limit(students_asc, 5)
smallest_students_report = project(smallest_students, keep=["university_name", "num_students", "international_students", "research"])

subset_research_summary = process(cleaned_universities, fn=subset_research_summary_v2, doc="Compares average research score and its difference from the overall cleaned-dataset average for the small highly international subset")
subset_top5 = process(cleaned_universities, fn=subset_top5, doc="Lists the five highest-research universities in the above-median international and below-median student-count subset")
gender_income_partial = process(cleaned_universities, fn=gender_income_stem, doc="Reports simple and STEM-adjusted female-to-male-ratio versus income correlations and full-dataset STEM counts")

stem_group_comparison = process(cleaned_universities, fn=compare_stem_means, doc="Compares STEM and non-STEM group means for ranking scores, income, and international-student percentage using dimension-specific non-missing values")

citation_factor_correlations = process(cleaned_universities, fn=citation_factor_correlations, doc="Reports pairwise-complete Pearson correlations and two-sided p-values between citations score and four university characteristics")

stem_international_citations = process(cleaned_universities, fn=compare_international_citations_by_stem, doc="Reports pairwise-complete internationalization-citations correlations for STEM and non-STEM universities and deviations from the full cleaned dataset")

citation_interaction_regression = process(cleaned_universities, fn=fit_citation_interaction, doc="Fits citations on international student percentage, female-male ratio, and their interaction for complete cases and reports model fit and predictor significance")

research_quality_top5 = process(cleaned_universities, times_2016_filled, fn=build_research_quality, doc="Ranks cleaned universities by the mean of their citations, research, and international-student percentile ranks and flags overlap with the official-total top five")

gender_balanced_citation_residuals = process(cleaned_universities, citation_interaction_regression, fn=top_gender_balanced_residuals, doc="Ranks gender-balanced complete-case universities by positive citation residual and reports their research residuals")

mahalanobis_outlier_comparison = process(mahalanobis_all, cleaned_universities, fn=summarize_mahalanobis_outliers, doc="Summarizes multivariate outlier score means and compares factor-citation correlations with the full cleaned dataset")

For languages with no data in 2011, treat their 2011 share as 0. Report the 3 languages with the largest positive share changes and the 3 languages with the largest negative share changes. Report each language's 2011 share, 2021 share, and the change.

statements: top10_issue_year_counts = aggregate(join(top10_language_issues, issues_pre2022, on='name', how='inner', validate='many_to_many'), by=['name', 'year'], issues=sum('count'))
counts_2011 = filter(top10_issue_year_counts, lambda row: row['year'] == 2011)
counts_2021 = filter(top10_issue_year_counts, lambda row: row['year'] == 2021)
yearly_2011 = filter(yearly_issue_totals, lambda row: row['year'] == 2011)
yearly_2021 = filter(yearly_issue_totals, lambda row: row['year'] == 2021)
shares_2011_joined = join(counts_2011, yearly_2011, on='year', how='inner', validate='many_to_one')
shares_2021_joined = join(counts_2021, yearly_2021, on='year', how='inner', validate='many_to_one')
shares_2011_calc = map(shares_2011_joined, share_2011=float64(lambda row: row['issues'] / row['total_issues']))
shares_2021_calc = map(shares_2021_joined, share_2021=float64(lambda row: row['issues'] / row['total_issues']))
shares_2011 = project(shares_2011_calc, keep=['name', 'share_2011'])
shares_2021 = project(shares_2021_calc, keep=['name', 'share_2021'])
all_shares = join(join(top10_language_issues, shares_2011, on='name', how='left', validate='one_to_one'), shares_2021, on='name', how='left', validate='one_to_one')

shares_with_change = map(all_shares, share_2011_filled=float64(lambda row: 0.0 if row['share_2011'] is None else row['share_2011']), change=float64(lambda row: None if row['share_2021'] is None else row['share_2021'] - (0.0 if row['share_2011'] is None else row['share_2011'])))
share_change_view = project(shares_with_change, keep=['name', 'share_2011_filled', 'share_2021', 'change'], rename={'share_2011_filled': 'share_2011'})
positive_share_changes = limit(sort(share_change_view, by=[('change', 'desc'), 'name']), 3)
negative_share_changes = limit(sort(share_change_view, by=[('change', 'asc'), 'name']), 3)

repos_ranked = sort(repos_totals, by=[("total_repositories", "desc"), "language"])
top10_repositories = limit(repos_ranked, 10)
repo_issue_activity = join(top10_repositories, language_issue_totals, on=[("language", "name")], how="left", validate="many_to_one")
repo_issue_pr_activity = join(repo_issue_activity, language_pr_totals, on=[("language", "name")], how="left", validate="many_to_one")

activity_density = map(repo_issue_pr_activity, activity_density=float64(lambda row: (row["total_repositories"] + 0.0) if False else ((row["total_issues"] if row["total_issues"] is not None else 0) + (row["total_pull_requests"] if row["total_pull_requests"] is not None else 0)) / row["total_repositories"]))
activity_density_view = project(activity_density, keep=["language", "total_issues", "total_pull_requests", "total_repositories", "activity_density"])
activity_density_ranked = sort(activity_density_view, by=[("activity_density", "desc"), "language"])
activity_density_summary = aggregate(activity_density_view, highest_density=max("activity_density"), mean_density=mean("activity_density"))
activity_density_summary2 = map(activity_density_summary, density_difference=float64(lambda row: row["highest_density"] - row["mean_density"]))
issue_pr_common = join(language_issue_totals, language_pr_totals, on="name", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
ols_summary = process(issue_pr_common, fn=fit_ols)
ols_outlier_results = process(issue_pr_common, fn=ols_outliers)
common_top10 = join(top10_language_issues, top10_language_prs, on="name", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
common_issue_changes = join(common_top10, share_change_view, on="name", how="inner", validate="one_to_one", suffix="_issue")
common_both_changes = join(common_issue_changes, pr_share_change_view, on="name", how="inner", validate="one_to_one", suffix="_pr")
common_with_repos = join(common_both_changes, repos_totals, on=[("name", "language")], how="inner", validate="many_to_one")

classified = map(common_with_repos, category=str(lambda row: "dual rising" if row["change"] > 0 and row["change_pr"] > 0 else ("dual declining" if row["change"] < 0 and row["change_pr"] < 0 else "mixed")))
category_means = aggregate(classified, by=["category"], mean_repository_count=mean("total_repositories"))

classified_view = project(classified, keep=["name", "change", "change_pr", "total_repositories", "category"], rename={"change":"issue_share_change", "change_pr":"pull_request_share_change", "total_repositories":"repository_count"})
classified_sorted = sort(classified_view, by=["category", "name"])
category_means_sorted = sort(category_means, by=["category"])

def compare_full_claim_latest(screened, full_titles, categories, search, current_scores):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    markets = screened.loc[screened['section'].eq('screened_top_five'),'country'].tolist()
    base = dict(zip(current_scores.loc[current_scores['section'].eq('screened_top_five'),'country'], current_scores.loc[current_scores['section'].eq('screened_top_five'),'score']))
    s = search.copy()
    s['momentum'] = s['mean_2019'] - s['mean_2015']
    s['mom_pct'] = s['momentum'].rank(pct=True, method='average') * 100
    rows = full_titles.copy()
    rows['w_frac'] = rows['country_fraction'].astype(float)
    rows['w_full'] = 1.0
    cats = categories[['show_id','category']].drop_duplicates()
    rc = rows[['show_id','country','added_year','type','w_frac','w_full']].merge(cats, on='show_id', how='left')
    def metrics(weight):
        x = rows.copy(); x['w'] = x[weight]
        g = x.groupby('country', dropna=False)
        credit = g['w'].sum()
        recent = x.loc[x['added_year'].isin([2018,2019])].groupby('country')['w'].sum()
        movies = x.loc[x['type'].eq('Movie')].groupby('country')['w'].sum()
        cats_n = rc.assign(w=rc[weight]).groupby('country')['category'].nunique()
        out = pd.DataFrame({'credit':credit, 'recent':recent, 'movies':movies, 'genres':cats_n}).fillna(0)
        out['delayed'] = 100 - 100*out['recent']/out['credit']
        out['movie'] = 100*out['movies']/out['credit']
        out['credit_pct'] = out['credit'].rank(pct=True)*100
        out['genre_pct'] = out['genres'].rank(pct=True)*100
        out = out.join(s.set_index('country')[['mom_pct']], how='inner')
        out['demand'] = out['mom_pct'] - out['credit_pct']
        out['country_score'] = .35*out['demand'] + .25*out['delayed'] + .10*out['movie'] + .10*out['genre_pct']
        return out
    frac = metrics('w_frac'); full = metrics('w_full')
    result=[]
    for m in markets:
        if m in frac.index and m in full.index:
            score=float(base[m] + full.loc[m,'country_score'] - frac.loc[m,'country_score'])
            result.append({'country':m,'score':score})
    result=sorted(result,key=lambda z:-z['score'])
    for i,r in enumerate(result,1): r['rank']=i
    top=set(r['country'] for r in result[:5])
    return pd.DataFrame([{'section':'screened_top_five','country':r['country'],'rank':r['rank'],'score':r['score'],'still_practical_shortlist':r['country'] in top} for r in result])

cast_detail = process(catalogue_raw, fn=lambda df: split_from_raw(df,'cast','cast_member'), doc="One trimmed cast token per title in listed order")
search_weekly = process(fn=load_search, doc="Loads country weekly search-interest series after removing non-date headers and converting values to numeric")
search_summary = aggregate(search_weekly, by=['country'], mean_2015=mean('interest'), mean_2019=mean('interest'), volatility=stddev('interest'), weeks=count('interest'))

definitions.source: file_list = process(fn=list_files, doc="Lists Indianapolis data files for selecting the use-of-force source")
raw_preview = scan("data/longds/social_good/center_for_policing_equity/task1/data/indianapolis/23-00089_UOF-P.csv", preview=8)
source = scan("data/longds/social_good/center_for_policing_equity/task1/data/indianapolis/23-00089_UOF-P.csv", skip_lines=1, all_text=True)
source_head = limit(source, 8)

clean0 = map(source, normalize, doc="Drops descriptive metadata fields, retains nonblank-shift episodes, and normalizes dates, booleans, numeric ages and tenure with blank categorical values as Unknown")
with_shift = filter(clean0, lambda r: r['shift'] is not None, doc="Keeps force episodes with a non-empty shift")
final_answer = process(with_shift, fn=final_audit3, doc="Reports lower-harm higher-safety common shifts, Canine fit, and cleaned-data audit values")
force_counts = aggregate(with_shift, by=["force_raw"], episodes=count())
shift_counts = aggregate(with_shift, by=["shift"], episodes=count())
safe_rows = filter(with_shift, lambda r: r["shift"] in ["DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle", "Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "ND Middle Shift"], doc="Keeps episodes in the four safer common shifts")
safe_sample = limit(safe_rows, 20)

aged = map(with_shift, lambda r: {**r, "age_gap": None if r["officer_age"] is None or r["subject_age"] is None else r["officer_age"]-r["subject_age"], "harm": 1 if r["officer_inj"] or r["officer_hosp"] else 0, "safe_flag": 1 if r["shift"] in ["DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle", "Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "ND Middle Shift"] else 0}, doc="Adds officer-minus-subject age gap, officer harm indicator, and safer-shift membership")
aged_valid = filter(aged, lambda r: r["age_gap"] is not None and r["officer_gender"] is not None and r["subject_gender"] is not None, doc="Keeps episodes with observed ages and both genders")

side = map(aged_valid, lambda r: {**r, "age_side": "excess" if r["age_gap"] >= 10 else ("deficit" if r["age_gap"] <= -10 else "near")}, doc="Labels age gaps as officer-age excess, deficit, or near parity")
cell_counts = aggregate(side, by=["safe_flag","officer_gender","subject_gender","age_side"], episodes=count(), harm_mean=mean("harm"))
comparison = process(side, fn=compare_harm, doc="Compares mean officer harm inside versus outside safer shifts for adequately sized gender-age cells")
overall_comparison = aggregate(aged_valid, by=["safe_flag"], episodes=count(), mean_harm=mean("harm"))
force_mix = process(side, fn=force_mix_contradictions, doc="Selects the eligible force family contributing most in the relevant direction to each carried gender-age contradiction")
arrest_audit = process(source, fn=arrest_audit, doc="Audits arrest flags and charge labels")
admin_rows = filter(clean0, lambda r: r["charge_raw"] is not None and "administrative" in r["charge_raw"].lower(), doc="Keeps cleaned episodes with administrative-hold arrest labels")
admin_summary = aggregate(admin_rows, by=["charge_raw","arrest","shift"], episodes=count())
admin_raw = process(source, fn=find_admin, doc="Finds administrative-hold and warrant arrest labels in source fields")
arrest_labels = process(source, fn=arrest_labels, doc="Summarizes arrest labels containing administrative holds or warrants")
revised_shift_metrics = process(with_shift, fn=revised_shift_metrics, doc="Ranks common shifts by officer harm and revised non-substantive arrest false-positive rate")
shift_audit = process(with_shift, fn=shift_audit, doc="Compares common-shift harm and arrest safety under old and revised false-positive definitions")
shift_audit_ordered = sort(shift_audit, by=["shift"])
shift_audit_view = project(shift_audit_ordered, keep=["shift","n","harm","old_safety","new_safety"])
frontier = process(with_shift, fn=frontier, doc="Identifies common shifts on the lower-harm higher-safety Pareto frontier under revised arrest treatment")
old_frontier = filter(frontier, lambda r: r["old_front"] is True, doc="Keeps shifts on the original lower-harm higher-safety frontier")
new_frontier = filter(frontier, lambda r: r["new_front"] is True, doc="Keeps shifts on the revised lower-harm higher-safety frontier")

revised_clean = map(clean0, lambda r: {**r, "charge_raw": None if (r["arrest"] is True and r["charge_raw"] is not None and ("administrative" in r["charge_raw"].lower() or "immediate detention" in r["charge_raw"].lower() or "warrant arrest" in r["charge_raw"].lower() or "warrant hold" in r["charge_raw"].lower())) else r["charge_raw"]}, doc="Treats administrative holds and warrant arrests as no-charge false-positive arrest outcomes")
revised_shift_rows = filter(revised_clean, lambda r: r["shift"] is not None, doc="Keeps revised force episodes with a non-empty shift")
focus = process(with_shift, fn=focus, doc="Compares original safer shifts with nearby candidate shifts under revised arrest safety")
revised_shift_counts = aggregate(revised_shift_rows, by=["shift"], episodes=count())
exposure_eligible = filter(revised_shift_counts, lambda r: r["episodes"] >= 300, doc="Keeps shifts with at least 300 cleaned force episodes")

revised_safer_floor = filter(exposure_eligible, lambda r: r["shift"] in ["DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle", "Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "SE Late Shift"], doc="Keeps revised safer-shift identities that meet the 300-episode exposure floor")

original_safer_floor = filter(exposure_eligible, lambda r: r["shift"] in ["DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle", "Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "ND Middle Shift"], doc="Keeps original safer-shift identities that meet the 300-episode exposure floor")

sensitivity = process(revised_shift_rows, fn=canine_sensitivity, doc="Applies a temporary Canine Bite severity of 5.0 and recomputes reportable safer shifts, contradiction cells, and leading force drivers")
sensitivity_detail = process(revised_shift_rows, fn=sensitivity_detail, doc="Shows exposure-eligible shift harm and revised safety under the temporary Canine severity penalty")

sensitivity_final = process(revised_shift_rows, fn=canine_sensitivity_final, doc="Recomputes exposure-eligible safer shifts, contradiction cells, and leading force drivers with Canine Bite severity set to 5.0")
incident_probe = process(revised_shift_rows, fn=inspect_incidents, doc="Inspects force-row identifier repetition to determine the incident collapse key")

incidents = process(revised_shift_rows, fn=collapse_incidents, doc="Collapses repeated force rows into one incident using modal categories, mean ages and tenure, any-event flags, maximum force severity, and a multi-force marker")
incident_counts = aggregate(incidents, by=["shift"], incidents=count())
incident_screen = filter(incident_counts, lambda r: r["incidents"] is not None and r["incidents"] >= 150, doc="Keeps shifts with at least 150 collapsed incidents")

reportable_incidents = filter(incidents, lambda r: r["shift"] in ["DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle", "Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "SE Late Shift"] and r["shift"] in ["Canine Section", "NW Late Shift", "SE Late Shift", "DT Late Tact Foot and Bicycle"], doc="Keeps incidents in the earlier exposure-eligible safer-shift candidates")
incident_metrics = process(reportable_incidents, fn=incident_metrics, doc="Reports collapsed-incident harm and revised arrest false-positive rates for earlier safer-shift candidates")
incident_audit = process(revised_shift_rows, incidents, fn=audit_row_incidents, doc="Audits earlier safer-shift candidates against force-episode and collapsed-incident exposure floors")

shrinkage_top = process(revised_shift_rows, incidents, fn=driver_shrinkage, doc="Compares force-row and collapsed-incident harm for eligible drivers in the fixed exposure universe and ranks shrinkage")

severity_audit=process(revised_shift_rows, incidents, fn=sharper_audit, doc="Recomputes incident safer shifts with the sharper force severity scale and compares the two earlier force-driver families")

mixed_check = process(revised_shift_rows, incidents, fn=mixed_row_incident_check, doc="Compares row-level revised-arrest harm scores with collapsed-incident scores under the sharper severity scale while holding the prior incident safer-shift set fixed")
mixed_result = process(mixed_check, fn=mixed_summary, doc="Summarizes safer-shift overlap and identifies the shift with the largest absolute row-to-incident harm-score drift")
cohort_result = process(incidents, fn=cohort_audit, doc="Compares race-age risk and cohort shares inside the current incident safer-shift pool using revised age boundaries")

cohort_restore_check = process(incidents, fn=earlier_cohort_compare, doc="Compares White-subject Boomer and Black-subject Millennial harm under the earlier age-cohort boundaries inside the incident safer-shift pool")
temporary_check = process(incidents, fn=multi_force_check, doc="Checks Canine, race-age migration, and gender-age contradiction after removing multi-force incidents")
weighted_audit = process(incidents, fn=weighted_incident_audit2, doc="Applies weighted arrest, scaled severity, and hospitalization harm to safer-shift and race-age findings")

drift = process(revised_shift_rows, incidents, fn=drift_audit, doc="Compares weighted and pre-weighted harm means across the fixed shift universe and race-age groups inside the weighted safer shifts")

definitions.source: file_inventory = process(fn=list_files, doc="Lists the available Netflix catalogue and weekly search-interest files")
catalogue_raw = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv", preview=5)
search_raw = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/australia.csv", preview=8)
catalogue_source = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/netflix_titles.csv")
search_australia = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/australia.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_canada = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/canada.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_egypt = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/egypt.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_france = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/france.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_hongkong = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/hongkong.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_india = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/india.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_japan = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/japan.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_mexico = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/mexico.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_south_korea = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/south_korea.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_spain = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/spain.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_taiwan = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/taiwan.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_thailand = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/thailand.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_turkey = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/turkey.csv", skip_lines=2)
search_uk = scan("data/longds/business/netflix_movies_and_tv_shows/task3/data/uk.csv", skip_lines=2)

cleaned_titles = map(catalogue_source, clean_catalogue_row, doc="Standardizes title fields, parses mixed catalogue-addition dates, derives duration, seasons, release decade, lag, and compact rating fields")

country_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=lambda df: make_detail(df, "country", "country", True), doc="One row per title and non-empty country token with listed order, token count, and equal fractional credit")
category_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=lambda df: make_detail(df, "listed_in", "category"), doc="One row per title and non-empty listed-category token in listed order")
director_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=lambda df: make_detail(df, "director", "director"), doc="One row per title and non-empty director token in listed order")
cast_detail = process(cleaned_titles, fn=lambda df: make_detail(df, "cast", "cast_member"), doc="One row per title and non-empty cast token in listed order")
search_summary = process(fn=load_search_summary, doc="Summarizes weekly search interest by market with 2015 and 2019 means, momentum, and full-period sample volatility")

quality = process(cleaned_titles, country_detail, category_detail, director_detail, cast_detail, search_summary, fn=quality_report, doc="Reports retained title and detail-row counts, search-market coverage, and missingness in standardized title fields")
period_titles = filter(cleaned_titles, lambda row: row["added_year"] is not None and row["added_year"] >= 2010 and row["added_year"] <= 2019, doc="Keeps titles added from 2010 through 2019")
sole_country_detail = filter(country_detail, lambda row: row["token_count"] == 1, doc="Keeps country assignments where the title has exactly one listed country")
assigned_titles = join(sole_country_detail, period_titles, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_one", suffix="_title")
assigned_categories = join(category_keys, assigned_market_keys, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_one", suffix="_market")

opportunity_top5 = process(assigned_market_keys, assigned_categories, search_summary, fn=market_opportunity, doc="Ranks search-tracked single-country markets by a weighted early opportunity score after the minimum title-credit screen")
assigned_market_keys = project(assigned_titles, keep=["title_id", "country", "fractional_credit", "type", "rating_group", "added_year"])
category_keys = project(category_detail, keep=["title_id", "category"])
dominant_components = map(opportunity_top5, dominant_component, doc="Identifies the largest weighted score contribution for each selected market")
full_assigned_titles = join(country_detail, period_titles, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_one", suffix="_title")
full_market_keys = project(full_assigned_titles, keep=["title_id", "country", "type", "rating_group", "added_year"])
full_assigned_categories = join(category_keys, full_market_keys, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_many", suffix="_market")

full_opportunity_report = process(full_market_keys, full_assigned_categories, assigned_market_keys, search_summary, fn=full_market_scan, doc="Ranks full-claim search-tracked markets and reports entrants, departures, and largest title-credit gains versus the conservative scan")
full_top5 = limit(full_opportunity_report, 5)
full_credit_gains = limit(full_opportunity_report, 5, offset=5)
fractional_market_keys = project(country_detail, keep=["title_id", "country", "fractional_credit"])
fractional_period_keys = join(fractional_market_keys, period_titles, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_one", suffix="_title")
fractional_market_keys_period = project(fractional_period_keys, keep=["title_id", "country", "fractional_credit", "type", "rating_group", "added_year"])
fractional_assigned_categories = join(category_keys, fractional_market_keys_period, on="title_id", how="inner", validate="many_to_many", suffix="_market")

fractional_opportunity_report = process(fractional_market_keys_period, fractional_assigned_categories, full_market_keys, search_summary, fn=fractional_scan, doc="Ranks fractional country-credit opportunities and compares full-claim versus fractional standing")
fractional_top5 = filter(fractional_opportunity_report, lambda row: row["record_type"] == "top", doc="Keeps the five leading markets under fractional country credit")
inflated_markets = filter(fractional_opportunity_report, lambda row: row["record_type"] == "inflated", doc="Keeps the five markets whose full-claim rank is most inflated versus fractional credit")

entropy_report = process(fractional_market_keys_period, fractional_assigned_categories, search_summary, fn=entropy_market_scan, doc="Ranks qualifying fractional-credit markets using category-token Shannon entropy and reports rank movement versus simple category breadth")

full_entropy_comparison = process(full_market_keys, full_assigned_categories, fractional_market_keys_period, fractional_assigned_categories, search_summary, fn=entropy_claim_comparison, doc="Compares full co-production claims with fractional country credit using Shannon category entropy")
entropy_top5_membership = process(full_entropy_comparison, fn=entropy_top5_membership, doc="Lists the top five markets under full-claim and fractional-credit entropy scoring")

volatility_penalty_report = process(full_entropy_comparison, search_summary, fn=apply_volatility_penalty, doc="Penalizes fractional entropy opportunity scores by 15 percent of each market's full-period search-volatility percentile and ranks top-five membership")

volatility_penalized_top5 = filter(volatility_penalty_report, lambda row: row["penalized_top5"] is True, doc="Keeps the five markets with the highest volatility-penalized fractional entropy opportunity scores")
volatility_membership_changes = filter(volatility_penalty_report, lambda row: row["membership_change"] is True, doc="Keeps markets whose top-five membership changes after the volatility penalty")

freshness_comparison = process(volatility_penalty_report, fractional_market_keys_period, cleaned_titles, search_summary, fn=freshness_scan, doc="Measures valid-lag fresh supply and ranks the top eight volatility-adjusted markets by demand gap minus fresh-supply share")
freshness_top5 = limit(freshness_comparison, 5)
freshness_debug_result = process(fractional_market_keys_period, cleaned_titles, fn=freshness_debug, doc="Checks title-key matching and valid release-to-add lag coverage for freshness measurement")
search_schema = process(search_summary, fn=inspect_search, doc="Inspects the search-summary fields used for demand-gap reconstruction")
freshness_answer = project(freshness_top5, keep=["market","demand_gap","fresh_supply_share","fresh_shortfall","demand_gap_minus_fresh_share"])

four_year_freshness_report = process(volatility_penalty_report, fractional_market_keys_period, cleaned_titles, freshness_comparison, fn=four_year_freshness, doc="Recomputes freshness-adjusted opportunity scores with a four-year release-to-add freshness boundary and compares current top-five membership")

continuation_report = process(freshness_comparison, country_detail, cleaned_titles, fn=continuation_scan, doc="Measures 2020-2021 fractional title-credit continuation after 2018-2019 and ranks the fresh-supply opportunity pool")
continuation_top5 = limit(continuation_report, 5)

continuation_debug_result = process(country_detail, cleaned_titles, freshness_comparison, fn=continuation_debug, doc="Checks continuation title matching and year-specific fractional credits for the freshness opportunity pool")

maturity_sensitivity_report=process(volatility_penalty_report,country_detail,cleaned_titles,search_summary,fn=maturity_sensitivity,doc="Ranks the ten strongest markets after freshness and continuation scoring with an uncertain-maturity penalty")
rating_values = process(cleaned_titles, fn=inspect_ratings, doc="Lists cleaned catalogue maturity labels and their frequencies")
rating_debug_result = process(country_detail, cleaned_titles, fn=rating_debug, doc="Checks uncertain maturity labels after joining country credits to cleaned titles")
maturity_final_report=process(continuation_report,country_detail,cleaned_titles,fn=maturity_final,doc="Ranks the ten current continuation-adjusted markets after penalizing uncertain maturity share")
final_maturity_sensitivity=process(maturity_sensitivity_report,country_detail,cleaned_titles,fn=lambda base,c,t: base,doc="Reports the final uncertain-maturity sensitivity results")
